This accreditation positions Oracle alongside Microsoft and Amazon Web Services, which have also been cleared for similar highly sensitive data hosting.

title: Oracle cloud authorized to host top secret data for DOD
summary: Oracle has received authorization to host top secret and sensitive compartmentalized information (TS/SCI) and special access program data for the Department of Defense, specifically the Air Force. The company achieved an Authority to Operate (ATO) for its "National Security Regions" which are designed with robust security features. This accreditation allows Oracle to process some of the Air Force's most sensitive data, joining other major cloud providers like Microsoft and Amazon Web Services in this capability.

title: Trip.com To Launch Hybrid Work In Chinese Tech Sector First
summary: Trip.com Group is set to become the first major Chinese tech company to implement a hybrid work model, allowing employees to work remotely two days a week starting March 1st. Executive Chairman James Liang stated that a six-month trial showed a one-third reduction in staff turnover and improved efficiency without a significant impact on performance. This move aims to boost morale and challenge the prevalent "996" overwork culture in China's tech sector.

title: F5 Strengthens Protection of the Digital World with F5 Distributed Cloud Services
summary: F5 announced a significant expansion of its application security and delivery portfolio with F5 Distributed Cloud Services, a unified SaaS platform offering security, multi-cloud networking, and edge-based computing solutions. The company also launched F5 Distributed Cloud WAAP, integrating various security capabilities into one SaaS offering to simplify security management for modern and legacy applications across diverse environments. This move addresses the increasing complexity and threats faced by organizations operating multi-cloud and hybrid application architectures.

title: Oracle gets go-ahead to host top secret Air Force data
summary: Oracle has received authorization to host top-secret U.S. Air Force data on its National Security Regions cloud platforms. This expands Oracle's role in the military sector, allowing it to handle highly sensitive information for the Department of Defense. The company has a history of government contracts, including involvement with the Air Force's Advanced Battle Management System and the CIA's Commercial Cloud Enterprise.

title: How to Not Stress About Tech
summary: The article discusses how investors can avoid stressing over the tech sector's current volatility by being selective and focusing on quality companies. It highlights the Goldman Sachs Innovate Equity ETF (GINN) as an example of a fund that invests in profitable, cash-generating tech firms with strong competitive advantages, distinguishing them from “pandemic losers.” The piece emphasizes that while some pandemic-driven tech trends are fading, long-term secular growth themes persist, making selective tech investments still attractive.

title: SPYG, VOOG, And IVW: It's Gut Check Time For Owners Of These S&P 500 Growth Funds
summary: This article examines three S&P 500 Growth Index ETFs: SPYG, VOOG, and IVW, highlighting their strong past performance and heavy concentration in mega-cap stocks. It suggests that while these funds are solid long-term choices, current market conditions, including a downward trend in earnings surprises, might present a better entry point in the future. The author also suggests considering the Invesco S&P 500 Pure Growth ETF for a different approach.

title: Corporate Leadership Won’t Reach Gender Parity Until 2060 at Its Current Rate
summary: A Morningstar analysis indicates that at the current rate of progress, women will not achieve representation parity in corporate leadership until 2060. The study found that the gender pay gap in the C-suite widened in 2020, reversing previous improvements, with women earning significantly less than men, particularly in share-based compensation. This persistent gap highlights institutional barriers despite some incremental increases in female representation at the executive level.

title: How to Let Go of Stress About Tech
summary: The technology sector has had a rough start to the year, but investors shouldn't abandon it. Rather than stressing over technology stocks, investors can embrace quality names over speculative ones through exchange traded funds like the Goldman Sachs Innovate Equity ETF (GINN). GINN focuses on profitable, cash-generating companies with wide competitive moats, such as Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia, which are expected to perform better as pandemic-related growth tails fade.

title: Build your knowledge of Azure AD conditional access policies
summary: This article explains how Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) conditional access policies help IT control access to resources in a dynamic, cloud-heavy environment. It details how these policies use signals and real-time risk intelligence to grant, restrict, or deny access, building a layered security approach. The article also covers the configuration of conditional access policies, including setting conditions based on user risk, sign-in risk, device platforms, and location, and how to filter access to privileged resources.

title: Inside Pat Gelsinger’s audacious $43.5B plan to revive Intel
summary: This article details Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger's plans to revitalize the company, which has recently faced significant challenges from competitors like Apple and AMD, and struggled with manufacturing delays. Gelsinger, who rejoined Intel after a period away, aims to tackle both technological and cultural issues to restore Intel's preeminence in the chip industry. His experience at Intel during its heyday positions him to address these intricate problems, including a new business model centered on investing $43.5 billion to regain its manufacturing edge.

title: Actual, which renders company ESG data in a SimCity-like platform, raises $5M seed
summary: Actual, a San Francisco-based startup, has secured $5 million in seed funding for its SimCity-like platform that visualizes and helps manage Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) data for companies. Founded by alums from LinkedIn and Airbus, the platform aims to assist businesses in modeling and executing their ESG plans to meet regulations and investor expectations. Actual's "model first" approach allows companies to use existing data, even low-resolution, to forecast future scenarios and transformations.

title: JPMorgan Chase, Toshiba and Ciena Build the First Quantum Key Distribution Network Used to Secure Mission-Critical Blockchain Application
summary: JPMorgan Chase, Toshiba, and Ciena have successfully built and demonstrated the first quantum key distribution (QKD) network for metropolitan areas, securing a mission-critical blockchain application. This groundbreaking research proves the viability of QKD to detect and defend against potential quantum computing attacks, supporting 800 Gbps data rates under real-world conditions. The network secured Liink by J.P. Morgan, the world's first bank-led, production-grade, peer-to-peer blockchain network, showcasing the technology's effectiveness against future quantum threats.

title: Insight Names Alexander L. Baum as Board Director
summary: Insight Enterprises has appointed Alexander L. Baum, a partner at ValueAct Capital and a significant investor in the company, as an independent director to its board. This addition aims to leverage Baum's extensive experience in IT industry strategy and investment expertise to further Insight's transformation into a leading solutions integrator. ValueAct Capital expresses excitement about deepening its relationship with Insight, believing its transformation in response to the changing IT landscape is underappreciated.

title: How the 'Big Short DAO' Bet Against the Crypto Market and Won
summary: The pseudonymous crypto trader @GiganticRebirth, also known as GCR, successfully bet against the crypto market's altcoins after sensing bearish sentiment at the market's peak in November. He assembled a team known as RebirthDAO to research tokenomics and market conditions, leading to profitable short positions on various altcoins. GCR's conviction was based on market exuberance, seasonal trends, and the inflationary nature of certain altcoins due to their unlock schedules.

title: After delaying over crime concerns, Weyerhaeuser says workers will return to downtown Seattle office
summary: Weyerhaeuser is set to reopen its Pioneer Square headquarters in April 2022, after delaying reopening efforts last fall due to concerns about street crime in downtown Seattle. The timber company will implement a hybrid work schedule for employees. This move follows similar announcements from Microsoft and Expedia, signaling a broader return to office for Seattle-based companies.

title: IBM exec referred to older workers as ‘dinobabies,’ suit says
summary: A lawsuit against IBM has revealed email communications where a high-level executive referred to older workers as "dinobabies" and expressed intent to usher them out to "accelerate change." The suit claims IBM had a "top-down plan to retain younger workers" to improve its demographic makeup. This incident highlights ongoing ageism concerns within IBM and the broader tech industry.

title: What’s Changed: 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Information Archiving
summary: The article analyzes the 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise Information Archiving, highlighting the evolving market driven by digital communication and application data. It discusses changes in vendor inclusion criteria, significant movements of key players like Global Relay and Veritas Technologies into the Leaders quadrant, and the strengths of various providers across the Leaders, Visionaries, and Niche Players categories, including Microsoft, Smarsh, Proofpoint, Mimecast, Micro Focus, ZL, Archive360, Solix Technologies, Barracuda, and Jatheon.

title: PE Firm Capficiency Acquires Microsoft SharePoint Partner KWizCom Corporation -
summary: Private equity firm Capficiency has acquired KWizCom Corporation, a Microsoft SharePoint applications developer, for an undisclosed sum. This acquisition expands Capficiency’s portfolio of IT companies, which also includes Appficiency, and aims to enhance their ability to provide innovative technology solutions to clients. Capficiency plans to continue pursuing merger, acquisition, and alliance opportunities to bolster the capabilities of both Appficiency and KWizCom.

title: How the Internet of Things is revolutionising the packaging industry
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming the packaging industry by enabling companies to move from reactive to predictive operations, particularly in achieving sustainability goals. GlobalData research highlights companies like Tetra Pak, Amcor, and Berry Global as leaders in implementing IoT to enhance efficiency and meet ESG targets. IoT, supported by technologies like 5G and AI, allows for smart decisions, automated processes, and significant cost savings, with global IoT revenue in manufacturing expected to reach $91 billion by 2025.

title: Timing: What Enterprises can learn from the Sports industry
summary: This article explores how the precision timing technologies used in the sports industry, such as RFID and high-speed cameras, can offer valuable lessons for enterprises. It highlights the evolution of timing technology in sports, from early photo-finishes to modern-day microsecond accuracy, emphasizing how these advancements build credibility and ensure fairness. The article then suggests practical applications of these technologies for businesses in various sectors, including toll collection, manufacturing, and event management, to improve operational speed, efficiency, and data collection.

title: Russia Ukraine Cyber Activity: Protect Against Related Cyberthreats
summary: This article details the escalation of Russia-Ukraine cyber activity, focusing on various threats like DDoS attacks, HermeticWiper malware, website defacement, phishing, and scam campaigns. It provides actionable recommendations for organizations to protect themselves, including patching critical software, preparing for ransomware/data destruction, and locking down networks. Palo Alto Networks describes how its products and Unit 42 services can help mitigate these evolving cyberthreats.

title: Why you shouldn’t schedule that next meeting
summary: The article discusses how virtual meetings, which became prevalent during the pandemic, have led to "Zoom fatigue" and decreased productivity due to an excessive focus on meetings over actual work. Experts suggest that businesses should re-evaluate the necessity and format of meetings, advocating for more thoughtful scheduling and leveraging technology for asynchronous collaboration to improve efficiency in the hybrid workplace. The goal is to be intentional about meeting objectives and explore alternatives like emails or chat platforms to ensure productive engagement.

title: Accelerating Innovation Across the Portfolio: Blackstone Collaborates with Microsoft
summary: Blackstone's Portfolio Operations team is collaborating with Microsoft to accelerate digital transformation and improve operating performance across its portfolio companies. By leveraging Microsoft Cloud technologies, portfolio companies can standardize digital capabilities, integrate data for analytics, and accelerate innovation, as exemplified by Merlin Entertainments' rapid adoption of an Azure-based data lake. This strategic alliance aims to drive growth and create value through tailored industry solutions and enhanced digital infrastructure.

title: Salesforce employees revolt over NFT moves
summary: Hundreds of Salesforce employees have revolted against the company's planned move into the NFT market, citing environmental and economic concerns. An open letter signed by over 400 workers addresses cofounder Marc Benioff and co-CEO Bret Taylor, raising issues about the high carbon footprint of blockchain technology and the speculative nature of NFTs. This internal backlash comes shortly after Salesforce highlighted its sustainability efforts, creating a perceived conflict between its stated values and its explorations in the NFT space.

title: Snack Giant Mondelēz International Moves Global Operations onto All-Digital Workspace with Orange Business Services
summary: Mondelēz International is transforming its global operations with an all-digital communications platform based on Microsoft Teams, managed by Orange Business Services. This initiative will unify communication and collaboration for 80,000 employees across 80 countries, eliminating legacy PBX systems and optimizing costs. Orange Business Services will also integrate advanced analytics and A.I. to enhance customer experience, personalize employee service, and provide comprehensive oversight of Mondelēz's operations.

title: Mixed reality helps GE Healthcare train engineers to service complex equipment
summary: GE Healthcare, in collaboration with Microsoft MRPP partner Adjacentech Corporation, has developed a mixed-reality training system using HoloLens 2. This system aims to improve training efficiency and knowledge retention for engineers servicing complex medical equipment like CT and MRI scanners in China. By overlaying holographic 3D visualizations onto real-world objects, the solution provides accurate step-by-step guidance, reducing training time and the risk of equipment damage.

title: What Microsoft's Acquisition of Activision Blizzard Means For Its Gaming Future
summary: Microsoft's acquisition of Activision Blizzard for $68.7 billion is poised to significantly strengthen its position in the gaming industry. The deal grants Microsoft a massive boost in mobile gaming through Activision's King subsidiary and enhances its console gaming library with popular titles like Call of Duty and Diablo. It is also expected to propel the growth of Xbox Game Pass by integrating Activision Blizzard's extensive catalog, attracting its 400 million monthly active players.

title: U.S. Bank Partners With Microsoft to Accelerate the Future of Banking With Cloud Computing
summary: U.S. Bank has announced a significant partnership with Microsoft, selecting Microsoft Azure as its primary cloud provider to modernize its technology foundation. This move aims to accelerate innovation, improve data analysis, and quickly scale new banking products and services for customers and partners. The transition is expected to enhance security, customer privacy, and strengthen technology risk management, while also improving the bank's ability to offer personalized digital experiences.

title: TikTok Star Corporate Natalie Wants You to Know a Few Things About Gen Z
summary: TikTok star Corporate Natalie provides business leaders with insights on how to support Gen Z in the workplace. She highlights the struggles of young workers adapting to hybrid work environments and offers advice on networking, empathy, leveraging side hustles for skill development, and fostering vulnerability. The article emphasizes the unique challenges faced by Gen Z in a post-pandemic work world and how leaders can address them.

title: Warner Music and BlackRock Invest $750 Million in Influence Media, Female-Led Music-Rights Firm
summary: Warner Music Group and BlackRock have jointly invested $750 million in Influence Media, a female-led music-rights firm. This partnership aims to acquire music-rights catalogs from female and diverse artists, focusing on newer, active catalogs rather than established older artists. Influence Media, founded by Lylette Pizarro and Lynn Hazan, plans to work with artists who will retain a stake in their work, and has already invested $300 million in 20 catalogs, including that of songwriter-producer Tainy and hitmaking team The Stereotypes.

title: What you can learn from one co-op’s ransomware attack
summary: Crystal Valley Cooperative, a Minnesota-based agricultural co-op, fell victim to a ransomware attack in September 2021, believed to be perpetrated by a Russian-speaking criminal group. The attack encrypted their files, rendering systems inaccessible for weeks and causing significant logistical challenges during harvest, forcing manual operations and leading to substantial costs for recovery and enhanced security measures. The co-op's experience highlights the importance of robust cybersecurity, even for smaller entities, and the broad impact of such attacks beyond just ransom payments.

title: Hoonigan Brings the Halo Infinite Warthog to Life with 1,000+ Horsepower and Twin Garrett Turbos
summary: Hoonigan, in partnership with Microsoft, has successfully recreated the Halo Infinite Warthog, transforming the fictional vehicle into a real-life beast with over 1,000 horsepower. The build features a custom V8 engine enhanced with twin Garrett GTX3576R Gen II turbochargers, all-wheel drive, and specialized off-road suspension. This engineering feat aimed to meet demanding specifications, including high-speed capability and extreme off-road performance, proving the Warthog's formidable power on the dyno.

title: AT&T Private 5G Edge to Make Private 5G Networks Smarter, Simpler, and More Flexible for Businesses, Schools, and Other Organizations
summary: AT&T is launching "AT&T Private 5G Edge," a new service developed in collaboration with Microsoft, aimed at making private 4G/5G networks simpler and more flexible for various organizations. This integrated platform will provide connectivity and applications with low-latency services at the edge, including the capability to roam onto AT&T's public network. The service leverages Azure private MEC and is designed to support use cases across manufacturing, automotive, and healthcare, allowing for easier adoption and scalability of private cellular networks.

title: U.S. Bank to keep Chaska data center open after move to cloud
summary: U.S. Bank announced its adoption of Microsoft’s Azure for cloud services to run its applications, signaling a shift to a cloud-first approach. Despite this move, the bank plans to keep its data center in Chaska operational. This strategy marks a significant change from their past investments in data centers.

title: How DBMS is Used by Hulu, JPMorgan Chase, and The Weather Company
summary: This article examines how Database Management Systems (DBMS) are crucial for organizations to efficiently store, retrieve, and manage data. It provides case studies of how major companies like Hulu, JPMorgan Chase, and The Weather Company leverage DBMS to address challenges, optimize operations, and maintain data integrity and security, highlighting the benefits over traditional file systems. The article demonstrates the real-world applications and positive outcomes of integrating DBMS in various industries.

title: Global X Launches Dow 30 Covered Call ETF
summary: Global X has launched a new ETF, the Global X Dow 30 Covered Call ETF (DJIA), aimed at generating income through covered call writing around the Dow Jones Industrial Average. This ETF, listed on the NYSE with a 60 basis point expense ratio, is designed to track the DJIA Cboe BuyWrite v2 Index. It will make monthly distributions and save investors the effort of individually executing a covered call strategy.

title: Capital Group Dividend Value ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:CGDV)
summary: The Capital Group Dividend Value ETF (CGDV) is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that primarily invests in dividend-paying, large and mid-cap US companies, aiming to produce income exceeding the average yield on US stocks. Launched on Feb 22, 2022, CGDV has assets under management of $35.92 billion and a current dividend yield of 1.14%. The ETF has seen a 12.3% increase in its stock price this year and its top holdings include NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Broadcom.

title: CRM giant Salesforce acquiring B.C.’s Traction on Demand
summary: Salesforce.com Inc. is acquiring B.C.-based software firm Traction on Demand, which specializes in implementing marketing strategies using Salesforce's CRM services. The Burnaby-based company employs about 500 workers across British Columbia, and its founder had previously resisted selling the company. This acquisition follows Salesforce's recent spree of purchases, including Mobify and Slack Technologies Inc.

title: Duos Technologies helping make railroad industry safer
summary: Duos Technologies, based in Jacksonville, is enhancing railroad safety through the development of a rail car inspection portal that uses cameras and artificial intelligence. These portals allow cameras to inspect rail cars moving at high speeds from numerous angles, generating safety reports that help mechanical carmen perform their jobs more efficiently and safely from a computer screen. The company, founded in 2001, aims to convince the historically traditional railroad industry to adopt this new technology, projecting significant revenue growth for 2022.

title: U.S. Bank partners Microsoft for cloud banking tech upgrade
summary: U.S. Bank has partnered with Microsoft, selecting Microsoft Azure as its primary cloud provider to modernize its technology infrastructure. This collaboration aims to provide the bank with greater flexibility, faster data access and analysis, and accelerated product development, leveraging AI and machine learning while ensuring customer privacy and security. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella emphasized the growing need for financial institutions to build digital capabilities to meet evolving customer demands.

title: Electrolux
summary: Electrolux, a century-old innovator in home appliances, has implemented IBM's AI-driven operations (AIOps) solutions to automate its global IT infrastructure, significantly reducing IT issue resolution times and improving overall efficiency. This adoption of AIOps, particularly IBM Cloud Pak for Watson AIOps, allows Electrolux to streamline event correlation, enhance expertise within its IT teams, and contribute to its ambitious environmental sustainability goals, including achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. The initiative has shown benefits ranging from faster problem-solving and cost savings to supporting remote work and integrating with manufacturing operations for improved efficiency and resilience.

title: How CFOs can supercharge their organization’s sales forecasting
summary: CFOs face a significant challenge in accurately forecasting sales, as traditional methods are often manual, time-consuming, and prone to becoming outdated quickly. The article introduces the "virtual sales forecast" (VSF) as a modern solution that leverages analytical tools, data connections, and automation to provide more accurate, granular, and frequently updated sales projections. By implementing a VSF, organizations can empower various departments with real-time insights, leading to better strategic planning and operational efficiency.

title: General Dynamics IT President Amy Gilliland Named to 2022 Wash100 Award for Leadership in Cloud Modernization and Cybersecurity Services
summary: Amy Gilliland, president of General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT), has been named a 2022 Wash100 Award recipient for her leadership in cloud modernization and cybersecurity services. This marks her fifth consecutive inclusion on the annual list, recognizing her influence and ability to maintain GDIT's stability and growth. Under her leadership, GDIT secured significant contracts, including a $4.5 billion agreement with the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency and a $190 million contract to migrate the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office's IT infrastructure to the cloud.

title: Amazon, General Mills, IBM, Microsoft, and Nestle Join 150+ Major U.S. Companies To Oppose Anti-Transgender Legislation in Iowa
summary: Over 150 major U.S. companies, including Amazon, General Mills, IBM, Microsoft, and Nestle, have publicly opposed anti-LGBTQ+ legislation across the country, particularly targeting transgender youth. Business leaders emphasize that such discriminatory laws negatively impact recruitment, retention, and overall business operations, making it difficult to attract and keep talent. The Human Rights Campaign and Freedom for All Americans highlight that these policies harm employees, customers, and communities, urging lawmakers to abandon discriminatory efforts.

title: Samsung Joins Forces with Industry Leaders to Advance 5G vRAN Ecosystem
summary: Samsung has partnered with Dell, HPE, Intel, Red Hat, and Wind River to advance the 5G virtualized RAN (vRAN) ecosystem. This collaboration aims to drive innovation and multiparty efforts for more scalable, flexible, and reliable software-based networks. Samsung, a leader in fully-virtualized 5G RAN, seeks to move vRAN and Open RAN beyond lab tests to major commercial markets with this new ecosystem.

title: Lockheed and Microsoft collaborating on 5G military tech
summary: Lockheed Martin and Microsoft are collaborating to enhance U.S. military communications by integrating Lockheed's hybrid base station technology with Microsoft's Azure cloud services for 5G military applications. This partnership aims to deliver mission-critical solutions at the tactical edge, with successful demonstrations already conducted at Lockheed Martin Space’s 5G test range in Colorado. The initiative, named 5G.MIL, seeks to leverage commercial 5G advancements for military use, building on Lockheed's previous efforts and a recent DoD contract for a 5G testbed.

title: KYNDRYL REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL-YEAR 2021 RESULTS
summary: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: KD) reported its fourth-quarter and full-year 2021 financial results, with full-year revenues totaling $18.7 billion and a net loss of $2.3 billion. The company is strategically positioning itself for growth through new partnerships with cloud hyperscalers and key initiatives focused on increasing signings, transforming service delivery, and addressing substandard margins. Kyndryl also announced significant strategic partnerships with major cloud providers and an expanded customer base following its spin-off from IBM.

title: Arista Networks Inc. stock underperforms Monday when compared to competitors
summary: Arista Networks Inc. (ANET) stock declined by 0.62% to $122.73 on Monday, underperforming the broader market. Despite a previous two-day winning streak, the stock closed below its 52-week high and fared worse than some competitors like Microsoft Corp. (MSFT), which saw a gain. Trading volume was also below its 50-day average.

title: Adobe named a Leader for fifth consecutive year in 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Digital Experience Platforms
summary: Adobe has been recognized as a Leader for the fifth consecutive year in the 2022 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Digital Experience Platforms, positioned highest and furthest to the right for both Ability to Execute and Completeness of Vision. The company highlights its market-leading technology in integrated insights, AI/ML (Adobe Sensei), content management, scale and breadth (handling 21.5 trillion segment evaluations daily), real-time personalization, and the foundational Adobe Experience Platform. Adobe emphasizes its commitment to helping businesses deliver personalized customer experiences at scale, highlighting trust, data privacy, and efficient workflow management with Adobe Workfront as critical components for success.

title: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC stock falls Monday, underperforms market
summary: Seagate Technology Holdings PLC (STX) shares fell 1.66% on Monday, closing at $103.16. This decline occurred during a generally grim trading session for the stock market, with the S&P 500 and Dow Jones also experiencing drops. The stock traded below its 52-week high and showed mixed performance compared to competitors like Microsoft Corp. (MSFT), HP Inc. (HPQ), and Western Digital Corp. (WDC).

title: Accenture and Microsoft to Assist Mount Sinai Health System on Five-Year Transformation Journey to Cloud
summary: Accenture and Microsoft are partnering with Mount Sinai Health System for a five-year cloud transformation journey, migrating its clinical applications, including Epic electronic health records, to Microsoft Azure. This strategic move aims to accelerate innovation, enhance patient engagement, and achieve operational efficiencies by allowing Mount Sinai to reinvest cost-savings into its healthcare mission. Accenture will provide managed services post-migration, while Microsoft will ensure quality assurance during the Azure transition.

title: Check Point releases 2022 Cloud Security Report
summary: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd. has released its 2022 Cloud Security Report, highlighting the challenges organizations face in securing cloud infrastructures amidst increasing cloud adoption, a cyber-skills shortage, and a rise in cloud security incidents, primarily due to misconfigurations. The report suggests a growing preference for independent cloud security solutions over cloud vendor security to streamline management across multi-cloud environments. TJ Gonen, VP of Cloud Security at Check Point, emphasizes the need for integrated third-party solutions with unified dashboards to simplify cloud security, reduce misconfiguration risks, and support application development in the cloud.

title: Microsoft Corp Chief Satya Nadella’s son passes away
summary: Zain Nadella, the 26-year-old son of Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and his wife Anu, passed away on Monday morning. Born with cerebral palsy, Zain's journey profoundly influenced Satya Nadella's focus on designing accessible products at Microsoft. The Children's Hospital, where Zain received treatment, collaborated with the Nadella family to establish the Zain Nadella Endowed Chair in Pediatric Neurosciences.

title: Leveraging Technology to Improve The Lives of P&G Consumers
summary: P&G utilizes advanced data-processing technologies like machine learning and artificial intelligence to enhance its products, understand consumer behavior, and streamline operations. This technology-driven approach, which began over five years ago, impacts everything from product development and quality control to personalized consumer communication and supply chain logistics. P&G's strategy focuses on connecting data, facilitating data scientists' work, and developing talent to continuously improve products and consumer experiences.

title: Leaders in Semiconductors, Packaging, IP Suppliers, Foundries, and Cloud Service Providers Join Forces to Standardize Chiplet Ecosystem
summary: A consortium of leading technology companies, including ASE, AMD, Arm, Google Cloud, Intel, Meta, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Samsung, and TSMC, has formed to standardize the chiplet ecosystem. They have ratified the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) 1.0 specification, an open industry standard for die-to-die interconnects, aiming to enable multi-vendor compatibility for System-on-Chip construction. The consortium is open for membership and plans to develop future generations of the UCIe technology.

title: EA, Oracle Among Companies Heeding Ukraine Plea to Stop Business in Russia
summary: Ukraine has requested that approximately 50 tech companies, including Oracle and EA, cease operations in Russia to isolate the country and pressure its government following military action. In response, Oracle announced the suspension of all operations in the Russian Federation, and EA Sports committed to removing Russian national and club teams from its FIFA games. Other major companies like Spotify, Twitter, Meta, Microsoft, and Google have also taken steps to restrict Russian state media or suspend services in Russia.

title: Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) group combines AMD, Arm, Google, Intel, TSMC and more
summary: The Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) group, formed by major tech companies like AMD, Arm, Google, Intel, and TSMC, has established a new industry consortium. Their goal is to standardize die-to-die interconnect guidelines and foster an open chiplet ecosystem, developing the UCIe 1.0 specification for interoperable multi-vendor chiplet components. This initiative aims to drive innovation in customizable package-level integration and address future challenges in semiconductor systems.

title: Micron Delivers World’s Most Advanced 176-Layer NAND Data Center SSD
summary: Micron Technology has announced the sampling of the world's first vertically-integrated 176-layer NAND solid-state drive (SSD) for data centers, the Micron 7450 SSD with NVMe. This new SSD offers QoS latency below two milliseconds, a wide range of capacities from 400GB to 15.36TB, and various form factors to cater to challenging data center workloads. It integrates Micron's advanced 176-layer NAND, DRAM, internally developed SoC, and firmware, emphasizing security through features like the Secure Execution Environment (SEE) and support for Open Compute Project (OCP) deployments.

title: DigitalOcean vs Cloudflare — which stock can take advantage of cloud expansion?
summary: This article compares DigitalOcean Holdings (DOCN) and Cloudflare (NET), two cloud computing companies, to determine which is the better investment. DigitalOcean serves developers and SMBs, while Cloudflare focuses on web security and content delivery. The analysis concludes that Cloudflare is the less risky and better investment due to its continued large client growth and potential for SMB expansion, despite DigitalOcean's strong performance and hold in the SMB market.

title: Wide Moat Stock Outlook Remains Compelling
summary: The article discusses the compelling outlook for wide moat stocks, highlighting their historical outperformance, especially in rising interest rate and high inflation environments. It notes that while the VanEck Vectors Morningstar Wide Moat ETF (MOAT) is outperforming the S&P 500 year-to-date, its performance is impacted by highly valued mega-cap growth stocks, which now present opportunities to buy quality at a discount. The analysis emphasizes that wide economic moats protect companies for extended periods, contributing to long-term outperformance with less volatility.

title: After clearing all regulatory hurdles, Microsoft closes $20B Nuance deal
summary: Microsoft has finalized its $20 billion acquisition of Nuance Communications after successfully navigating all regulatory approvals, including those from the U.S. Justice Department, the EU, and the British Competition and Markets Authority (CMA). This move signifies Microsoft's deeper entry into the healthcare sector, with CEO Satya Nadella indicating plans to expand Nuance's AI technology beyond healthcare into other verticals like financial services and telecommunications. The CMA concluded that the acquisition would not substantially lessen competition in the healthcare transcription market.

title: DXC Is Pulling Out Of Russia, Condemns ‘Unprovoked Attack On Ukraine’
summary: DXC Technology announced its exit from the Russian market in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine, impacting approximately 4,000 employees. The company condemned the "unprovoked attack" and stated it would no longer pursue business in Russia, while also providing support to its employees in the region, including financial assistance and relocation support. This move follows similar actions by other major IT firms and has raised concerns among solution providers about potential increases in cyberattacks.

title: EA pulling games and virtual currency sales from Russia and Belarus
summary: Electronic Arts (EA) has announced that it will halt the sale of its games, content, and virtual currency in Russia and Belarus across all its platforms, including regional storefronts, in-game stores, and Origin. This decision comes as a protest against the invasion of Ukraine and follows similar actions by other major game companies like Microsoft and CD Projekt. Existing players in these regions will still retain access to previously purchased titles.

title: Activision CEO Bobby Kotick will leave Coca-Cola's board before Microsoft deal closes
summary: Activision Blizzard CEO Bobby Kotick will not seek re-election to Coca-Cola's board of directors, a position he has held for 10 years, to focus on the impending $68.7 billion merger with Microsoft. This decision comes amidst controversy surrounding Kotick, including allegations of misconduct within Activision and scrutiny over his political funding. A non-profit investor group had previously urged Coca-Cola not to renominate Kotick due to these issues.

title: Microsoft suspends all new sales of its products and services in Russia
summary: Microsoft has announced its decision to suspend all new sales of its products and services in Russia, joining a growing list of companies reacting to the conflict in Ukraine. Company president and vice chair Brad Smith stated their solidarity with Ukraine, emphasizing the call for peace and protection of its people. Microsoft is also committed to protecting Ukraine's cybersecurity and supporting its Ukrainian employees.

title: Consortium formed to standardize chiplet ecosystem
summary: A consortium comprising major tech companies like Intel, AMD, Arm, Google Cloud, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Samsung, and TSMC has been formed to standardize the die-to-die interconnect and foster an open chiplet ecosystem. They have ratified the UCIe 1.0 specification, which provides a ubiquitous interconnect standard for package-level integration, enabling easy mixing and matching of chiplet components from multiple vendors for System-on-Chip construction. The consortium aims to address customer demand for customizable package-level integration and reduce development time and cost through open standards.

title: Microsoft Vaults Further Into Health-Care Services With Closing of Nuance Deal
summary: Microsoft has completed its $19.6 billion acquisition of Nuance Communications Inc., significantly expanding its presence in the health-care services market and artificial intelligence. The deal integrates Nuance's AI technology, which assists doctors in patient prediction and digital record-keeping, into Microsoft's cloud-computing and AI offerings for health care, finance, and customer service sectors. Nuance currently serves a large portion of U.S. hospitals and top financial institutions.

title: How Hyperscale Data Centers are reshaping India’s IT
summary: Hyperscale data centers are critical infrastructure for companies like Amazon, Google, and Microsoft, providing dedicated computing resources to handle massive user demands. These facilities are essential for the digital economy, supporting everything from emails to online shopping, and their importance has grown with trends like remote work and emerging technologies such as AI and IoT. India is poised for significant growth in its data center industry, driven by government incentives and an increasing need for robust data storage and processing capabilities, despite environmental concerns related to energy consumption.

title: Electronic Arts halts all sales in Russia and Belarus
summary: Electronic Arts (EA) has announced that it will cease all sales of games and content in Russia and Belarus due to the ongoing Russian invasion of Ukraine. This includes sales through Origin, the EA app, and platform partners. EA also confirmed that it had previously removed Russia and Russian clubs from its FIFA and NHL 22 games and is working with partners to delist its games from stores in the affected regions.

title: Microsoft closes on $16 billion acquisition of Nuance
summary: Microsoft has completed its $16 billion acquisition of speech recognition company Nuance Communications. This deal, Microsoft's second-largest, aims to expand its presence in the healthcare industry through Nuance's medical dictation and transcription tools. The acquisition received clearance from British and European Union antitrust regulators after initial scrutiny.

title: The Scale of Shell's Global AI Predictive Maintenance Program
summary: Shell has successfully scaled its AI-driven predictive maintenance program to monitor over 10,000 pieces of equipment globally, significantly reducing operating costs, preventing downtime, and improving safety and environmental outcomes. This achievement, made possible through a partnership with C3 AI and Microsoft Azure, involves ingesting 20 billion rows of data weekly and running over 10,000 machine learning models. Shell is now making its predictive maintenance solutions commercially available through the Open AI Energy Initiative to accelerate the energy transition across the industry.

title: Constellation Launches Sustainability Partnership with Microsoft featuring 24/7/365 Real-Time Carbon-Free Energy Matching Solution
summary: Constellation announced a strategic five-year partnership with Microsoft to develop a 24/7/365 real-time carbon-free energy matching solution. This technology aims to help customers fully achieve their zero-emissions goals by matching real-time electricity use with local clean energy sources, offering a more precise carbon accounting method than current annual offsetting practices. Microsoft will also become an early adopter of this solution and purchase clean energy from Constellation.

title: Cloud management provider Cloocus receives $41 mn in Series B funding
summary: Cloud management service provider Cloocus Co. has secured $40.8 million (50 billion won) in Series B funding from SK Inc. C&C as part of a larger 100 billion won round. This investment follows significant funding rounds for other Korean cloud MSPs like Megazone Cloud and Bespin Global. The capital injections reflect a turnaround for Korean MSPs, driven by increased demand for cloud services due to the pandemic and the growing adoption of SaaS and multicloud strategies.

title: Class-action lawsuit targets NBA 2K’s microtransactions
summary: Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of NBA 2K22, is facing a class-action lawsuit filed by an Illinois parent regarding the game's MyTeam mode and its use of loot boxes. The lawsuit alleges "unfair, deceptive, and unlawful practices, including illegal gambling practices," and seeks over $5 million in damages. It claims these practices psychologically distance players, especially minors, from the reality of spending real money, a concern previously raised about similar systems in games like EA Sports' Ultimate Team.

title: Cloudflare and Akamai to continue operations in Russia
summary: Cloudflare and Akamai have stated their intention to continue operations in Russia despite calls to cease business following the invasion of Ukraine. Both companies argue that providing internet access is crucial for Russian citizens to obtain accurate information, rather than contributing to an information blackout. They have, however, condemned the invasion and ceased business with sanctioned entities or state-majority-owned customers.

title: Cisco Stops Business In Russia, Ups Security Efforts In Ukraine
summary: Cisco Systems has halted all business operations in Russia and Belarus in response to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. The company is also providing security assistance to Ukraine through its Talos threat intelligence team, offering free software auto-renewals, Webex meetings, and calls to the country. This move aligns Cisco with other major tech companies sanctioning Russia, and the company has also established a humanitarian fund for Ukraine.

title: Alphabet’s (GOOGL) Stock Price Has Fallen 12.8% in 2022. Should You Buy It?
summary: Alphabet's stock (GOOGL) has dropped 12.8% in 2022, leading many to question if it's a good buying opportunity. Despite plateauing ad revenues, Google is expanding into cloud services and cybersecurity, highlighted by its acquisition of Mandiant. The company is considered attractive at current prices, though antitrust concerns remain a risk.

title: Telco Lumen disconnects from Russia, ends business relationships
summary: Lumen Technologies, a US telecommunications company, has announced its complete disconnection from Russia due to increased security risks following the invasion of Ukraine. Initially, Lumen stopped selling new products and services to Russian entities and terminated existing agreements, and although its business interactions in Russia are not financially material, the company was a top international transit provider to the country. This move follows a similar decision by rival Cogent, leading other Russian telecommunication companies to shift to Lumen and other providers.

title: Industry Leaders Join Forces to Standardize Chiplet Ecosystem
summary: A consortium of industry leaders, including AMD, Arm, Google Cloud, Intel, Meta, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Samsung, TSMC, and ASE, has formed to standardize die-to-die interconnects and foster an open chiplet ecosystem. They have ratified the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) 1.0 specification, an open industry standard for package-level connectivity. This initiative aims to reduce development time and cost, promoting customizable and interoperable chiplet designs for future silicon innovations.

title: Our Ultimate Stock-Pickers' Top 10 Buys and Sells
summary: This article identifies the top 10 high-conviction buys and sells among Morningstar's Ultimate Stock-Pickers for the fourth quarter of 2021, based on an aggregate analysis of their holdings. It highlights key companies like Microsoft and 3M as top buys and Marsh & McLennan as a prominent sell, detailing the Morningstar analysts' fair value estimates, economic moats, and investment theses for these firms. The report assists investors by providing insights into attractive investment ideas and valuation considerations.

title: Adaptive Biotechnologies lays off 12% of workforce to narrow immunosequencing tech
summary: Adaptive Biotechnologies announced a layoff of 12% of its workforce (about 100 employees) as part of a restructuring to focus on two core areas: minimal residual disease and immune medicine. The company also appointed Tycho Peterson as the new CFO, a move analysts believe will positively impact its stock. These changes aim to streamline operations and clarify the company's mission for investors.

title: Billion-dollar Seattle company Adaptive Biotechnologies lays off 100
summary: Seattle-based Adaptive Biotechnologies, valued at $1.6 billion, announced a layoff of 100 employees from its 850-worker staff as part of a restructuring effort. The company is streamlining its workforce and appointing a new chief financial officer while focusing on its cancer diagnostic test, clonoSEQ, and infectious disease-specific cell mapping research. Despite a pandemic-driven stock price surge, shares have significantly declined from their January 2021 high.

title: Lumen (like the field) is pulling out of Russia. What's next?
summary: Lumen, an internet backbone company known for its naming rights to a Seattle sports stadium, is pulling its services out of Russia. This decision, following similar moves by other companies like Cogen, could significantly impact Russia's internet access, potentially leading to slower connectivity and isolation from the global web. An editor from DatacenterDynamics explains that Lumen's role as a major international transit provider means its withdrawal is a substantial move towards disconnecting Russia.

title: Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Experience Cloud modernize customer and employee experiences
summary: Adobe is enhancing the integration between Adobe Acrobat Sign and Adobe Experience Cloud to streamline digital document signing workflows for businesses. These advancements aim to improve efficiency, save time, and reduce costs. The new functionalities include faster e-signatures for work management, digitized commerce transactions, and personalized onboarding experiences.

title: Leaks of Conti Ransomware Group Paint Picture of a Surprisingly Normal Tech Start-Up... Sort Of
summary: A leak of hundreds of thousands of internal communications from the Conti ransomware group reveals a surprisingly corporate-like structure, complete with HR, hiring processes, salaries, and even performance reviews. The analysis details their organizational hierarchy, diverse teams (coders, testers, OSINT specialists), and recruitment methods, which include legitimate job sites. Despite the massive breach and internal turmoil, the article concludes that Conti is "Too Big To Fail" and will likely re-emerge.

title: Disney ‘Taking Steps to Pause’ All Business in Russia
summary: The Walt Disney Company announced it is "taking steps to pause" all other businesses in Russia, beyond its initial halt on new movie releases, due to the "unprovoked invasion of Ukraine" and escalating humanitarian crisis. This includes content and product licensing, Disney Cruise Line activities, National Geographic magazine and tours, local content productions, and linear channels. Disney stated that while some activities can be paused immediately, others will take time due to contractual complexities, and staff in Russia will remain employed.

title: Here’s How ICE Illegally Obtained Bulk Financial Records from Western Union
summary: Senator Ron Wyden has revealed that Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), a unit within ICE, illegally obtained millions of financial records from Western Union and Maxitransfers Corporation using administrative subpoenas. These subpoenas compelled the companies to provide records of money transfers over $500 to or from certain U.S. states and Mexico, which were then stored in a database accessible to hundreds of law enforcement agencies. This bulk surveillance is deemed illegal due to the misuse of administrative subpoenas, which are statutorily required to seek records "relevant" to specific investigations.

title: Biden must safeguard Russian internet access, civil society warns
summary: Civil society groups are urging the Biden administration to protect internet providers in Russia from sanctions, arguing that cutting off web access would isolate dissidents and strengthen the Kremlin's control. They recommend that the Office of Foreign Asset Controls formally authorize U.S. internet services, software, and hardware to preserve web access, citing precedents from past sanctions campaigns. The groups warn that without clear guidance, individuals in Russia could be cut off from vital internet services.

title: Grizzle Growth ETF (GRZZ) Stock Price, News, Quote & History
summary: This article provides detailed information on the Grizzle Growth ETF (GRZZ), including its current stock price, historical data, and performance metrics. It outlines the ETF's investment strategy, top holdings like NVIDIA and Microsoft, and sector weightings. The page also features related ETF news and research reports from analysts regarding other companies.

title: FIFA Ultimate Team cards aren’t gambling, Dutch court says
summary: A Dutch appeals court has overturned a 2020 ruling that declared EA Sports' FIFA Ultimate Team card packs a form of gambling, rescinding a €10 million fine against Electronic Arts. The court determined that opening card packs is part of a game of skill and not an isolated game of chance. Electronic Arts celebrated the decision, reiterating its commitment to player choice, fun, fairness, and value in game design.

title: Is India ready to embrace Industry 4.0?
summary: This article explores India's readiness for Industry 4.0, featuring an interview with Amit Saluja, Senior Director Head of NASSCOM center at Gandhinagar. Saluja discusses how Industry 4.0 differs from previous industrial revolutions by focusing on organizational transformation beyond just manufacturing, driven by AI, IoT, and analytics. He acknowledges India's slow start but highlights increased awareness and proactive adoption, especially among mid-sized companies, emphasizing that Industry 4.0 is crucial for future readiness rather than just immediate ROI.

title: Announcing Winners of the 2022 Workday Partner Innovation Awards
summary: Workday has announced the winners of its second annual Partner Innovation Awards, recognizing services and software partners for their outstanding contributions. These awards highlight specialized solutions that help Workday customers navigate a changing world, extending key Workday solutions across various industries. The winning innovations span financial services, healthcare, retail, technology, and more, demonstrating a commitment to customer success and technological advancement within the Workday ecosystem.

title: The Importance of Ink Cartridge Recycling
summary: This article discusses the environmental benefits of recycling ink cartridges, highlighting HP's closed-loop recycling program, Planet Partners. It explains how recycling helps reduce plastic waste, supports communities, and ensures the use of quality OEM products. The article also provides multiple convenient methods for consumers to recycle their used HP ink cartridges.

title: IonQ to Present Research at American Physical Society (APS) Annual Meeting 2022
summary: IonQ announced its participation in the American Physical Society (APS) March Meeting 2022, where co-founder and CTO Jungsang Kim will be honored for his pioneering contributions to quantum computing. IonQ researchers will present new advances in quantum chemistry simulations, risk aggregation using quantum generative modeling, and general quantum learning of joint probability distribution functions. The company will also discuss application-oriented performance benchmarks for quantum computing, including its new #AQ single-number benchmark.

title: Texas Roadhouse Partners With Ziosk to Roll Out a Tableside Ordering And Payment Platform
summary: Texas Roadhouse has implemented Ziosk's Cloud Commerce Platform, named Roadhouse Pay, for digital tableside ordering and payments, enhancing the dining experience with features like pay-at-the-table technology and NFC transactions. The service has seen high adoption rates and improved customer satisfaction, reflecting a growing industry trend towards tableside solutions since the pandemic. The tableside ordering and payment sector is becoming increasingly competitive, with several companies vying for market share.

title: Metaverse Technology Redefining Digital Experience
summary: The metaverse is emerging as a significant technological advancement, moving beyond gaming to redefine digital experiences across various industries. Companies like Facebook (Meta), Nike, and Microsoft are investing heavily, with projections indicating global metaverse revenue could approach $800 billion by 2024. While offering potential for retail, enterprise solutions, and new markets like virtual real estate and entertainment, the metaverse also faces challenges related to data security, legal frameworks, skilled resources, VR device limitations, and potential negative societal impacts.

title: Four ways companies can find the ‘hidden talent’
summary: Many companies struggle to find talent despite a large pool of "hidden workers." This article outlines four strategies for companies to tap into this underserved talent pool. These strategies include implementing "returnships," upskilling current employees, directly collaborating with educational institutions, and removing college degree requirements from job descriptions.

title: Coca-Cola FEMSA se transforma digitalmente para mantener siempre conectados a sus colaboradores
summary: Coca-Cola FEMSA has partnered with Microsoft to implement digital transformation initiatives, particularly focusing on Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams, to enhance communication and collaboration among its employees across 10 countries. This strategic alliance has allowed Coca-Cola FEMSA to optimize operational processes, maintain business continuity, and facilitate remote work, as evidenced by over 200,000 interactions among 19,200 employees and the successful virtual "Semana de Desarrollo" event. The company emphasizes the importance of flexible technological allies to adapt to changing operational needs and ensure continuity in a new normal.

title: CheckPoint vs Trend Micro | Full Disk Encryption Comparison
summary: This article compares Check Point Full Disk Encryption Software Blade and Trend Micro Endpoint Encryption, two cybersecurity tools designed to protect data on various devices. It details their features, including encryption standards, pre-boot authentication, deployment options, and reporting capabilities, to help organizations choose the best solution for their data protection needs. Both products offer robust encryption and management features, with pricing available upon contacting the respective vendors.

title: Embracing Automation Technologies: 5 Tips for Modernizing Mortgage Origination
summary: The article discusses the challenges faced by the mortgage origination industry, including cyclical market conditions, market disruption from fintechs, and shifting consumer expectations. It presents five tips for modernizing mortgage origination through automation: making automation a standard practice, being innovative without being disruptive, eliminating manual document processing, making the process painless and personalized, and enhancing a buyer's bargaining power. The authors advocate for an automation-first approach to reduce costs, increase speed to close, and improve customer experience.

title: Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices drops ‘medical devices’ in rebranding
summary: Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices has rebranded as Johnson & Johnson MedTech to reflect its deeper involvement in digital technology. The company stated this change aligns with its focus on breakthrough scientific innovation and reimagining health in an increasingly digital world, emphasizing smarter, less invasive, and more personalized healthcare solutions. The rebranding highlights its position as a leading medtech innovator, encompassing areas like interventional solutions, orthopedics, surgery, and vision.

title: Rimac Seguros Accelerates Its Digital Transformation by Migrating to Microsoft Azure with Kyndryl
summary: Kyndryl and RIMAC Seguros have announced a three-year agreement for Kyndryl to lead RIMAC's digital transformation, migrating its mission-critical IT systems and business applications to Microsoft Azure. This move aims to enhance the Peruvian insurance company's agility, resiliency, security, and compliance. The initiative will improve customer experiences through faster response times and business continuity, leveraging Kyndryl's cloud expertise and its strategic partnership with Microsoft.

title: Half of Perfect Dark core developers reportedly left The Initiative during 2021
summary: A report indicates that around 34 core developers, including the game director and lead level designer, left The Initiative in 2021 during the development of the Perfect Dark reboot. Despite this "exodus" leaving fewer than 50 people at the studio, management remains confident, and Crystal Dynamics continues to assist with development. The mass departure is speculated to be due to slow progress and a lack of creative freedom, potentially impacting the game's development.

title: SentinelOne acquires Attivo Networks for $617M
summary: SentinelOne is set to acquire Attivo Networks for $616.5 million, aiming to integrate Attivo's identity threat detection and response services, particularly for Active Directory and cloud environments, into its extended detection and response (XDR) offerings. This acquisition will expand SentinelOne's capabilities in identity and access management, addressing a critical gap in threat detection and user behavior analysis, especially given the rising trend of credential-based attacks. The move follows SentinelOne's significant IPO and is expected to bolster its hypergrowth and accelerate zero-trust adoption.

title: Goldman Sachs ActiveBeta World Low Vol Plus Equity ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (BATS:GLOV)
summary: This article provides details on the Goldman Sachs ActiveBeta World Low Vol Plus Equity ETF (GLOV), including its stock price, key statistics, and holdings. GLOV invests in large- and mid-cap stocks in developed markets, focusing on value, momentum, quality, and low volatility factors. The ETF was launched on March 15, 2022, and is managed by Goldman Sachs.

title: Webroot sues CrowdStrike, Sophos, others over alleged patent infringement
summary: Webroot and its parent company OpenText are suing Trend Micro, Sophos, Kaspersky, and CrowdStrike for alleged infringement of several malware detection patents, some dating back to 2005. The lawsuits, filed in the Western District of Texas, claim these defendants infringe upon Webroot's intellectual property related to endpoint security products and platforms. Competitors and observers criticized the move, with CrowdStrike calling it typical of a "patent troll" and others viewing it as "patent bullying."

title: Corporate tax departments face intertwined challenges: A talent shortage, regulatory uncertainty, and difficulty leveraging data
summary: Corporate tax departments are grappling with a talent shortage, an uncertain regulatory landscape, and difficulties in leveraging data effectively. A KPMG survey highlighted talent as the biggest risk, exacerbated by the ongoing "Great Resignation" and fewer individuals entering the accounting profession. Additionally, evolving business and regulatory environments require tax professionals to develop broader skill sets and utilize technology for strategic guidance, but many departments lack the necessary tools and expertise.

title: SaaS customer relationship management (CRM) Market size to grow by USD 44.17 billion | Retail end-users to exhibit maximum demand | Technavio
summary: The SaaS Customer Relationship Management (CRM) market is projected to grow by USD 44.17 billion between 2020 and 2025, exhibiting a CAGR of 14%. Retail end-users are expected to drive the highest demand, significantly contributing to market growth due to the expansion of retail and e-commerce. North America is anticipated to dominate the market geographically, accounting for 52% of the global market expansion, primarily driven by the increasing adoption of cloud-based offerings and the need for customer information analysis.

title: Electronic Arts stops sales in Russia, bans Russian teams from esports events
summary: Electronic Arts has ceased sales of its games, content, and virtual currency in Russia and Belarus in response to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine. The company has also removed Russian teams from its sports video games FIFA 22 and NHL 22, and banned teams from both Russia and Belarus from competing in official esports events. This action comes amidst a broader trend of companies, including Microsoft and CD Projekt Group, pulling out of the Russian market and following an appeal from Ukraine's deputy prime minister.

title: More than half of APAC Healthcare Technology start-ups surveyed see the pandemic as an enabler for innovation while talent recruitment is reported as the biggest challenge by the majority
summary: A Medtronic-Economist Impact whitepaper reveals that over half of APAC healthcare technology startups view the COVID-19 pandemic as a catalyst for innovation, despite talent recruitment being reported as the biggest challenge by 80% of surveyed startups. This finding was a key discussion point at the first Medtronic Open Innovation Conference (MAIC 2022) in Singapore, which aimed to foster collaboration within the healthcare technology ecosystem. Medtronic (NYSE:MDT) reinforced its commitment to the region by announcing plans to invest up to US$50 million through its Open Innovation Platform and the upcoming Digital Medtronic Innovation Center (dMIC) in Singapore.

title: Rogers and Microsoft announce strategic alliance to revolutionize hybrid workplace communications and power 5G innovation across Canada with Azure
summary: Rogers and Microsoft have announced a five-year strategic alliance to accelerate digitization for businesses in Canada, focusing on hybrid work and 5G-enabled solutions. Rogers will leverage Microsoft Azure for its cloud infrastructure and will be the first in Canada to offer Operator Connect Mobile, a comprehensive communication and collaboration solution built on Microsoft Teams. This partnership aims to enhance customer digital experiences, drive 5G innovation through Azure, and provide secure, reliable communication services, enabling businesses to reduce costs and improve agility.

title: Microsoft announces new research and technology to make hybrid work work
summary: Microsoft released its second annual Work Trend Index report, "Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work," and announced new features across Teams, Microsoft 365, Surface Hub, and Microsoft Viva to support hybrid work. The report highlights five urgent trends, including a new "worth it" equation for employees and challenges for managers and leaders in navigating hybrid work. Microsoft is introducing product innovations like Teams Connect shared channels, a new meeting layout for Teams Rooms, AI-powered Surface Hub 2 Smart Camera, and language interpretation features to improve the hybrid work experience.

title: Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work
summary: This article discusses the evolving landscape of hybrid work, highlighting how employee expectations have changed significantly since the pandemic, prioritizing health, well-being, and flexibility. Based on a Microsoft Work Trend Index study of 31,000 people, it outlines five key trends for leaders, emphasizing the need to empower managers, rethink the office's role, rebuild social capital in a digital-first world, and establish sustainable flexible work practices to avoid digital exhaustion. The study reveals that employees are actively reshaping their work lives, making flexibility and wellbeing non-negotiable for future success.

title: ProShares Metaverse ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:VERS) $VERS
summary: The ProShares Metaverse ETF (VERS) tracks the Solactive Metaverse Theme index, investing in companies poised to benefit from the Metaverse's development. As of the article's update, VERS has seen a 19.3% increase in share price this year, trading at $73.45.

title: Fortum and Microsoft announce world’s largest collaboration to heat homes, services and businesses with sustainable waste heat from new data centre region
summary: Fortum and Microsoft have partnered to create the world's largest waste heat recycling concept, using excess heat from a new Microsoft data center region in Helsinki to warm homes and businesses. This initiative will reduce approximately 400,000 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and utilize 100% emission-free electricity in the data centers. The project leverages Fortum's extensive district heating infrastructure, making Finland's energy system greener and promoting sustainable digitalization.

title: Zim worth over $10b
summary: Zim Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. has achieved a market capitalization exceeding $10 billion, with its share price rising nearly 500% since its IPO in January 2021. This surge is attributed to the boom in global shipping and supply chain disruptions. The company reported a record net profit of $4.6 billion in 2021, the largest ever by an Israeli company, and plans to allocate stock options to its CEO, chairman, and directors.

title: Microsoft announces new research and technology to make hybrid work, work
summary: Microsoft has released its second annual Work Trend Index report, "Great Expectations: Making Hybrid Work Work," alongside new features for Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Surface Hub, and Microsoft Viva to enhance hybrid work. The report identifies five key trends showing that employees have new expectations for work, emphasizing health and well-being, and that managers are caught between leadership and employee demands. Microsoft aims to help organizations adapt to these shifts with new technological innovations that improve collaboration and flexibility in a hybrid environment.

title: The Impact of Design on the Employee Experience
summary: Workday's Chief Design Officer, Jeff Gelfuso, emphasizes the importance of delivering seamless and engaging end-to-end experiences for employees within enterprise software, mirroring consumer software expectations. He discusses how Workday is achieving this through simplification, personalization, connectedness, and data-driven insights. The article highlights key design principles and Workday's initiatives like Engage, Everywhere, and Empower to improve the employee experience.

title: GM bets $3.5 billion more on self-driving tech unit as SoftBank exits
summary: General Motors (GM) is increasing its investment in its self-driving car subsidiary, Cruise, by approximately $3.5 billion, as SoftBank's Vision Fund exits its stake. GM will pay $2.1 billion to acquire SoftBank's share and make another $1.35 billion investment committed by SoftBank in 2018, bringing GM's total stake to 80%. This move raises questions about Cruise's near-term revenue generation and the financial commitment required from GM and its partners to fund the unit's development.

title: 3rd Gen AMD EPYC Processors with AMD 3D V-Cache Technology Deliver Outstanding Leadership Performance in Technical Computing Workloads
summary: AMD has announced the general availability of its 3rd Gen EPYC processors with AMD 3D V-Cache technology, codenamed "Milan-X." These processors are the world's first data center CPUs to use 3D die stacking and are built on the "Zen 3" core architecture. They offer up to a 66% performance uplift in technical computing workloads and feature the industry's largest L3 cache for applications like CFD, FEA, and EDA.

title: Regina Miracle
summary: Regina Miracle International Holdings Limited chose Check Point Harmony to enhance its cybersecurity defenses. The solution dramatically improved the company's ability to prevent phishing and malware attacks on files, endpoints, and credentials, while also simplifying security management across its over 7200 devices. These measures helped them gain better visibility into threats and significantly reduce time spent on security responses.

title: Billionaires Elon Musk and Michael Saylor: Dump the Dollar and Buy Physical Things
summary: Elon Musk and Michael Saylor advise investors to own "physical things" or scarce assets like Bitcoin instead of cash to combat high inflation. Musk, despite selling his homes and not considering digital assets "physical," champions property and stocks in good companies. The article emphasizes that cash is losing value due to inflation, while physical assets like homes and used vehicles have seen significant price increases.

title: IonQ Aria, Newest Quantum Computer, Coming to Microsoft’s Azure Quantum Platform
summary: IonQ announced a partnership with Microsoft to bring its latest quantum system, IonQ Aria, to the Azure Quantum platform. IonQ Aria, featuring 20 Algorithmic Qubits (#AQ), is considered the industry's most powerful quantum computer based on standard benchmarks. This collaboration aims to democratize access to quantum computing, allowing individuals with an internet connection to utilize IonQ Aria's capabilities.

title: Moon Studios’ “oppressive” culture could have affected Microsoft’s decision to not work with Ori devs again
summary: Moon Studios, known for the critically acclaimed Ori series, has been accused of fostering a toxic and oppressive workplace culture by former employees. This alleged mismanagement reportedly caused mental health issues for staff and may have been the underlying reason for Microsoft's decision to end its decade-long partnership with the studio. The studio's co-founders, Gennadiy Korol and Thomas Mahler, have denied the allegations, stating their commitment to fostering a vibrant culture.

title: The Best Microsoft Teams Apps for Team Tracking
summary: This article reviews several Microsoft Teams apps designed for team tracking and productivity. It highlights tools like Jibble for time and attendance, Human Resources (Dynamics 365) for leave management, Timeneye for project tracking, TimeClock 365 for attendance and location, AttendanceBot for PTO and shift planning, Vacation Tracker for leave requests, and Azure Boards for project management. The article aims to help businesses effectively monitor employee productivity, attendance, and project progress within the Microsoft Teams ecosystem.

title: Microsoft looks poised to dominate the quantum computing industry
summary: Microsoft has recently announced a breakthrough in quantum computing with the invention of "topological qubits," which they claim will lead to scalable quantum computers. This development positions Microsoft to become a major player in the quantum industry, complementing their existing Azure quantum services and a new partnership with Pasqal for near-term 1,000-qubit processor access. While the ultimate winner in quantum computing is uncertain, Microsoft's comprehensive strategy, including both long-term qubit research and immediate cloud solutions, suggests it's a strong contender for a dominant market share.

title: Baker Hughes Collaborates with C3 AI, Accenture, and Microsoft on Industrial Asset Management Solutions
summary: Baker Hughes is partnering with C3 AI, Accenture, and Microsoft to develop and deploy industrial asset management (IAM) solutions for clients in the energy and industrial sectors. This collaboration aims to enhance the safety, efficiency, and emissions profile of industrial assets by leveraging digital technologies. The companies will also explore solutions to help achieve net-zero carbon emissions, combining their expertise in AI, cloud infrastructure, and strategic integration.

title: Walmart Enters the Cloud Wars and Challenges Microsoft, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP
summary: Walmart is entering the highly competitive cloud computing market with SaaS-based retail and commerce solutions, challenging established players like Microsoft, Salesforce, Oracle, and SAP. This move stems from Walmart's decision to commercialize its extensive internal technology investments, transforming into both a consumer and creator of enterprise technology. The initiative, housed within Walmart Global Tech, aims to sell its "billion-dollar portfolio of cutting-edge technology" to other retailers, marking a significant shift in the industry-cloud segment.

title: Bionic Announces $65M Series B Financing from Insight Partners, Cyberstarts, and Battery Ventures
summary: Bionic, an Application Security Posture Management (ASPM) platform, has secured $65 million in Series B financing led by Insight Partners, with participation from existing investors Cyberstarts and Battery Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand its R&D efforts and scale its sales and customer success teams. This funding round follows significant growth for Bionic, which provides complete visibility and continuous monitoring of applications, services, and APIs to aid enterprise customers in managing application security risks.

title: Biden Can Fix the Anti-Worker H-1B Immigration Visa Scam
summary: The H-1B visa program, intended to fill US labor shortages with foreign workers possessing rare skills, has instead become a system of exploitation for both H-1B and American workers due to deficient labor safeguards. The article urges President Biden to use executive action to modernize these safeguards, enforce existing laws, and reform the program to protect workers and prevent wage theft, arguing that legislative reform is unlikely.

title: HubSpot Appoints Rob Giglio Chief Customer Officer
summary: HubSpot, a leading CRM platform, has appointed Rob Giglio as its new Chief Customer Officer. Giglio, who joins from DocuSign and previously spent 11 years at Adobe, will be responsible for overseeing HubSpot's flywheel organization and ensuring alignment across its marketing, sales, services, and revenue operations teams to enhance customer experience and drive strategic growth.

title: NetApp Cloud Insights gets AI monitoring and ransomware detection
summary: NetApp has enhanced its Cloud Insights infrastructure management software by integrating AI/machine learning capabilities. This upgrade enables automatic generation of IT infrastructure topologies, prediction of event impacts, and the detection of anomalous behavior to combat ransomware. The software also suggests solutions to administrators and can trigger data protection measures.

title: Keynote Wrap-Up: Turning Data Centers into ‘AI Factories,’ NVIDIA CEO Intros Hopper Architecture, H100 GPU, New Supercomputers, Software
summary: During NVIDIA GTC, CEO Jensen Huang unveiled a vision of data centers as "AI Factories," introducing the new Hopper GPU architecture and H100 GPU, along with new AI and accelerated computing software. He also announced powerful new data-center-scale systems, including Grace CPU Superchip and DGX H100 supercomputers. Huang emphasized the role of Omniverse in integrating real and virtual worlds, speeding collaboration, and serving as a proving ground for new robotics and autonomous vehicles.

title: NVIDIA Announces Availability of Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit to Advance Robotics and Edge AI
summary: NVIDIA has announced the availability of its Jetson AGX Orin developer kit, a powerful AI supercomputer designed for advanced robotics, autonomous machines, and edge computing.
