This new kit offers over eight times the processing power of its predecessor, the Jetson AGX Xavier, while maintaining a compact form factor. NVIDIA expects the Jetson AGX Orin to accelerate the development of next-generation robotics and edge AI products across various industries, supported by a broad ecosystem of partners and customers.

title: StarTree brings Apache Pinot real-time database to the cloud
summary: StarTree has launched its cloud service for the Apache Pinot real-time OLAP database, making it easier for organizations to deploy and manage this technology. This service, initially offered with a "bring your own cloud" (BYOC) model, allows users to run Pinot in their private cloud while StarTree handles management. Apache Pinot, originally from LinkedIn, is designed for rapid querying of large datasets for analytics and operational dashboards, and StarTree's offering aims to simplify data ingestion and observability.

title: What is Okta and how its hack could affect Cloudflare, Coinbase and others
summary: Identity management company Okta Inc. is investigating a digital breach, the scope of which is currently unknown. This hack could have significant implications for thousands of companies like Cloudflare and Coinbase that rely on Okta for access management. Okta, which serves over 15,000 customers and has more than 100 million registered users, is known for its Single Sign-On and Multi-factor Authentication services.

title: Towards The Distant Virtual World: Vitalii Vashchuk Shares Insights
summary: Vitalii Vashchuk, Director and Gaming Technologist at EPAM Systems, shared his insights on the metaverse's evolution and the underlying technologies. He describes the metaverse as a concept aimed at enhancing communication and experiences, offering greater freedom than Web2.0. Key technologies enabling the metaverse include Blockchain, NFTs, AI, and IoT.

title: 10 Servers With AMD EPYC Milan-X New Server CPUs
summary: AMD has launched its third-generation EPYC processors with 3-D V-Cache technology, code-named Milan-X, which is the world's first data center CPU using 3-D die stacking. This innovation allows for 768 MB of L3 cache, significantly enhancing performance for technical computing workloads like FEA, EDA, and CFD. Major server vendors such as Dell Technologies, HPE, Cisco, Lenovo, and Supermicro are rolling out new or upgraded servers supporting these processors, aiming to offer improved performance, lower total cost of ownership, and reduced power consumption.

title: NetApp is increasing targets thanks to CloudOps biz
summary: NetApp has raised its revenue targets due to the strong performance and growth prospects of its Cloud Operations (CloudOps) business. The company expects its public cloud annual recurring revenue (ARR) to reach $2 billion by fiscal year 2026, accelerating its $1 billion target by a year. NetApp's unique CloudOps portfolio, which helps customers manage and optimize applications in the public cloud, is seen as a key differentiator and a significant opportunity for expanding its customer base and cross-selling.

title: Tackling Global Supply Chain Disruption
summary: This article discusses how Microsoft has addressed global supply chain disruptions caused by the pandemic, focusing on leveraging technology for agility and resilience. It highlights digitizing factories, using AI/machine learning for data and logistics, and integrating sustainability. The article also introduces Microsoft's Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Insights as a solution for organizations seeking to build resilient supply chains.

title: First Trust Launches First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF
summary: First Trust announced the launch of its new First Trust Nasdaq Lux Digital Health Solutions ETF (Nasdaq: EKG), designed to track the Nasdaq Lux Health Tech Index. This ETF aims to provide investors with exposure to companies at the intersection of healthcare and technology, focusing on innovations in digital health. The index was created in partnership with Lux Capital to identify publicly-listed companies leading technological integration across various segments of the healthcare industry.

title: How To Multiply The QQQ’s Dividend Yield By 15
summary: This article criticizes the low dividend yield of Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) and suggests an alternative, Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund (QQQX), for significantly higher dividend income. The author explains how QQQX uses covered call options to generate a 7.3% dividend, contrasting it with QQQ's 0.5% yield and the less effective Global X Nasdaq 100 Covered Call ETF (QYLD). It highlights QQQX's strategy of cherry-picking profitable tech stocks and its advantage as a closed-end fund often trading at a discount.

title: C3.ai Digital Transformation Institute Announces Research Awards for AI to Transform Cybersecurity and Secure Critical Infrastructure
summary: The C3.ai Digital Transformation Institute (C3.ai DTI) has announced $6.5 million in research awards to advance the use of AI in cybersecurity and to secure critical infrastructure. Twenty-four projects across various universities, including UC Berkeley, UI Urbana-Champaign, and Carnegie Mellon, received funding ranging from $100,000 to $700,000. These projects focus on AI resilience, anomaly detection, advanced persistent threats, securing critical cyber-physical infrastructure, forensics, securing emerging financial infrastructure, vulnerability identification, and insider threats.

title: CIBC tackles developer shortage with hackathons, skill training
summary: CIBC is addressing the tech worker shortage by upskilling its current developers in high-demand areas like blockchain and Microsoft Azure, rather than solely recruiting external talent. The bank offers growth opportunities through training programs and hackathons, aiming to retain existing employees and attract new ones. This strategy comes as Canadian banks face intense competition for tech talent, leading to rising salaries and turnover rates in the industry.

title: New Fleet of IMAX 65mm Film Cameras Under Development
summary: IMAX is developing four new 15 perf/65mm film cameras in partnership with Kodak, Panavision, and FotoKem, with the first model expected in 2023. Directors Jordan Peele and Christopher Nolan are also providing creative feedback on these next-generation cameras, which aim to improve operability and reduce noise while maintaining the immersive IMAX experience. The initiative seeks to expand the capabilities of large-format 65mm film for filmmakers.

title: Netflix buys another video game studio as it builds out its gaming business. (Published 2022)
summary: Netflix announced it acquired Boss Fight Entertainment, a mobile game developer, marking its third studio purchase as it expands into the video game market. This move is part of Netflix's strategy to differentiate itself by leveraging popular shows for game development and eventually creating original games, aiming for a careful expansion after seeing other tech companies struggle in the gaming industry.

title: 16-year-old living with his mom is Lapsus$ mastermind behind Microsoft hack, cyber detectives say
summary: Cybersecurity researchers have traced a string of hacks against major technology companies like Microsoft, Nvidia, and Okta to a 16-year-old living with his mother near Oxford, England. This teenager, known online as "White" and "breachbase," is believed to be the mastermind behind the Lapsus$ hacking group, which has engaged in social engineering and extortion campaigns, often taunting victims and recruiting insiders. The group, which Microsoft tracks as "DEV-0537," is known for its poor operational security, allowing researchers to gain insights into its members who also include a suspected teenager in Brazil.

title: The High Costs and Low Returns of AML Compliance for Banks: Is There a Better Way?
summary: Financial institutions worldwide are struggling with high Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance costs and outdated transaction monitoring systems, leading to inefficiencies and an inability to keep pace with evolving financial crime typologies. The article suggests a strategic shift towards digital enhancement, particularly leveraging AI/ML, to optimize compliance algorithms, improve data accessibility, navigate regulatory complexities, and address talent gaps. It emphasizes that while RegTech offers valuable solutions, a thorough self-assessment and a structured, incremental transformation plan are crucial for achieving long-term success and cost savings.

title: General Dynamics IT Secures $95M AmeriCorps Cloud, Managed Services Contract
summary: General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) has been awarded a potential five-year, $95 million contract by AmeriCorps to provide enterprise IT services. Under this contract, GDIT will deliver cloud, managed services, cybersecurity, digital modernization, and operations center support, utilizing Microsoft Azure to modernize AmeriCorps' IT systems and support its national mission. The agreement aims to enhance AmeriCorps' productivity and IT operations, with a base term of nine months and several option periods.

title: Wolverine Enters the Halo-sphere with Launch of Limited-Edition Boot Inspired by The Master Chief
summary: Wolverine has collaborated with 343 Industries to release a limited-edition boot inspired by The Master Chief from the Halo franchise. This collaboration was sparked by fans noting the resemblance of Wolverine's Hellcat boot to Halo gear. The "Wolverine x Halo: The Master Chief" boot incorporates recognizable Halo elements and Wolverine's signature comfort and strength.

title: Cisco Systems Inc. stock rises Friday, outperforms market
summary: Cisco Systems Inc. (CSCO) saw its stock rise by 0.86% to $54.97 on Friday, outperforming the broader market. This marked the second consecutive day of gains for the company, though its stock remained $9.32 short of its 52-week high. Competitors Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) fell, while International Business Machines Corp. (IBM) and VMware Inc. (VMW) also saw gains.

title: Nouveau Monde Graphite Provides a Quarterly Update and Releases its Annual Report – Disciplined Execution of the Company’s Business Plan
summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite (NMG) has released its year-end financial results for 2021, showcasing significant progress towards completing its Phase-1 facilities and advancing its Phase-2 commercial scale-up. The company is nearing completion of its 2,000-tonnes-per-annum integrated graphite production line for anode material and is actively defining the economic model for its Phase 2 while engaging with potential customers and financial partners. NMG also highlights its commitment to ESG principles, carbon-neutral operations, and sustainability in its production of advanced graphite materials for the electric vehicle and renewable energy sectors.

title: Amazon Stock Rally Erases Losses for the Year
summary: Amazon.com Inc. shares rallied, becoming the first megacap tech stock to recover its losses for the year,

title: AudioCodes Launches Live Express for Quick Teams Voice Deployment
summary: AudioCodes has launched Live Express, a new SaaS product designed to simplify the deployment of voice capabilities for Microsoft Teams. This service, aimed primarily at Microsoft 365 partners, offers a cloud-based solution for PSTN connectivity via Direct Routing, enabling partners without deep voice expertise to offer Teams voice services. Live Express provides management tools for onboarding and controlling customer telephony, supporting a wider ecosystem for Teams voice alongside other AudioCodes offerings like Live Cloud and Live Teams.

title: HP’s $3.3B Acquisition Of Poly: Six Things You Need To Know
summary: HP announced its acquisition of Poly for $3.3 billion, aiming to strengthen its hybrid work solutions portfolio by integrating Poly's videoconferencing and audio capabilities. The deal, which includes Poly's debt, is seen as an opportunity for HP to leverage its extensive patent portfolio and global channels, with financial projections indicating immediate accretion to HP's revenue growth, margins, and non-GAAP EPS. While HP investors initially reacted negatively, the company emphasizes the long-term strategic value and market opportunity presented by the growth in hybrid work and under-equipped conference rooms.

title: IonQ Announces Full Year 2021 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
summary: IonQ announced its full year 2021 financial results, significantly exceeding its initial contract bookings forecast with $16.7 million and achieving $2.1 million in revenue. The quantum computing leader also provided a 2022 financial outlook, projecting revenue between $10.2 million and $10.7 million, alongside significant commercial and technical advancements including a major deal with Hyundai and achieving 20 algorithmic qubits with IonQ Aria.

title: Why has higher education decided on Zoom?
summary: This article explores why Zoom became the dominant videoconferencing platform in higher education during the pandemic, despite a crowded market. The author discusses factors such as ease of use, stability, cost, marketing, and specific features like breakout rooms, while also noting criticisms regarding privacy and accessibility. The piece concludes by suggesting that Zoom's success has created inertia, making it difficult for other platforms or even emerging technologies like VR to compete.

title: What’s Changed: 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms
summary: This article analyzes changes in Gartner's 2022 Magic Quadrant for Analytics and Business Intelligence Platforms, highlighting new market trends and vendor shifts. It details the leaders, challengers, visionaries, and niche players, noting additions and removals from the previous year's report. The report emphasizes visual self-service, augmented AI, and the divergence of traditional BI from data science and machine learning.

title: Pwning Microsoft Azure Defender for IoT | Multiple Flaws Allow Remote Code Execution for All
summary: SentinelLabs uncovered critical vulnerabilities in Microsoft Azure Defender for IoT, including flaws in the password recovery mechanism and several SQL injection vulnerabilities, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. These vulnerabilities, tracked with CVEs, impact both cloud and on-premise customers, leading to potential full network compromise if unpatched. Microsoft has released security updates to address these issues, urging users to update immediately.

title: Trimble Execs Discuss XR for AEC, Industry 4.0
summary: Trimble executives discuss their mixed reality (MR) and extended reality (XR) solutions for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry, emphasizing their partnership with Microsoft for products like the XR10 and FieldLink MR. They also highlight their Trimble Technology Labs, which aim to train the future workforce in construction technology and further the digitalization of the industry. The article explains how Trimble bridges the gap between the physical and digital worlds to create what they call Industry 4.0.

title: Vectra: Using AI Technology to Strengthen Cybersecurity
summary: Blackstone is partnering with Vectra, a company that utilizes AI technology to combat escalating cybersecurity threats. Vectra's innovative software identifies and stops breaches by learning normal network behavior and detecting anomalies across various digital environments. This partnership aims to expand Vectra's reach within Blackstone's portfolio companies, enhancing cybersecurity for many organizations.

title: Best Global Company Culture 2022
summary: Comparably’s annual Best Global Company Culture list for 2022 ranks the top large companies (over 500 employees) with international operations based on anonymous employee feedback collected over the past year. The list highlights companies with strong cultures across nearly 20 categories, including compensation, leadership, and work-life balance, making it a relevant resource for job seekers worldwide. Microsoft, IBM, and Google took the top three spots, respectively, among the 50 recognized global companies.

title: Keurig brews a more perfect cup of coffee with Azure IoT Central
summary: Keurig Dr Pepper is leveraging Azure IoT Central to revolutionize the coffee experience with connected brewers featuring BrewID™ technology. This solution enables personalized brewing, simplifies fleet management for commercial partners, and provides valuable consumer insights. The use of Azure IoT Central significantly reduced development time and accelerated time to market for Keurig’s smart brewers.

title: Microsoft Azure to take on Cloudflare, Akamai with new-look CDN service
summary: Microsoft has revamped its Azure Front Door content delivery network (CDN) with a new version now generally available, aiming to compete with services like Cloudflare and Akamai. The updated service, available in Standard and Premium tiers, offers improved architecture, security features, and integrations, while the older "classic" versions will no longer receive new enhancements. Microsoft promises "zero downtime migrations" to encourage users to move to the new platform.

title: Builder.ai raises $100M Series C led by Insight Partners to scale up its software automation
summary: Builder.ai has successfully raised $100 million in a Series C funding round led by Insight Partners, bringing its total funding to $195 million. The company, which provides an "AI-powered low-code/no-code app development platform," saw significant growth during the pandemic by offering pre-packaged apps for small businesses. This new capital will be used to further enhance its AI and automation capabilities, including the development of a conversational AI named "Natasha."

title: Best Places To Work: Seattle Metropolitan Area 2022
summary: Comparably has released its list of the Best Companies in the Seattle Metropolitan Area for 2022, based on anonymous employee ratings collected over the past year. The rankings consider nearly 20 workplace culture categories, including compensation, leadership, and work-life balance. Microsoft, Smartsheet, and T-Mobile topped the list of 15 companies acknowledged for their positive work environments.

title: Pala Band of Mission Indians to sell iGaming firm for $170M
summary: The Pala Band of Mission Indians is selling its iGaming software company, Pala Interactive LLC, to Boyd Gaming Corp. for $170 million. The tribe intends to use the proceeds to pay down debt and invest in new revenue-generating acquisitions as part of its strategic plan to move away from owning a tech company. The sale is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 2023, with Pala Interactive's existing management team remaining in place.

title: IonQ Named As One Of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies
summary: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), a leader in trapped-ion quantum computing, has been recognized on TIME’s annual TIME100 Most Influential Companies list for its leadership in commercializing quantum computing. The company was included in the "New Frontiers" category, acknowledging its extraordinary impact and recent achievements, including the introduction of IonQ Aria, the world's most powerful quantum computer. This recognition follows a year of significant business momentum and technical breakthroughs for IonQ.

title: Synopsys Launches Industry's First Broad-Scale Cloud SaaS Solution to Transform Chip Development Landscape
summary: Synopsys has launched Synopsys Cloud, the industry's first broad-scale cloud Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution for chip development. This new model, optimized for electronic design automation (EDA) and deployed on Microsoft Azure, offers a pay-per-use approach to provide unparalleled flexibility and efficiency for complex chip designs. The collaboration with Microsoft aims to streamline access to compute and EDA resources, addressing the escalating demands of chip design and verification.

title: Outbrain expands strategic partnership with Microsoft, leveraging Microsoft Azure to improve business outcomes for media owners and advertisers – Middle East & Africa News Center
summary: Outbrain Inc. and Microsoft have expanded their strategic partnership, with Outbrain leveraging Microsoft Azure for its media platform. This multi-year engagement aims to accelerate innovation, global expansion, and improve connectivity for advertisers and publishers on Outbrain's platform. The partnership reinforces both companies' commitment to supporting independent journalism and enhancing business outcomes through advanced technology.

title: Chemours partners with Open Systems, modernizing cybersecurity to mitigate threats
summary: The Chemours Company partnered with Open Systems to modernize its cybersecurity defenses, eliminating 30 different security products by adopting the Microsoft 365 E5 security stack. This transformation offers a cohesive security environment, allowing Chemours' Security Operations team to gain a unified view of threats and ensure a more strategic and cost-effective approach to cybersecurity. The partnership has significantly enhanced Chemours' ability to protect its manufacturing processes, intellectual property, and data.

title: The Unintended Consequences of Taxing Unrealized Capital Gains
summary: President Biden's proposed "Billionaire Minimum Income Tax" targets households worth over $100 million and would levy a 20% tax on both realized and unrealized capital gains. This article argues that taxing unrealized gains, such as the appreciation of a home not yet sold, could have significant negative consequences, including forcing billionaires like Elon Musk to sell large portions of their company stock, potentially impacting the broader market and 401(k)s. The author contends that the proposal is driven by envy and misunderstands the tax contributions already made by high-income earners.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Construction ISV Adds Civil Construction Tools
summary: SIS, LLC has released a civil-highway version of its Construct 365 product suite, which extends Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. This new offering targets heavy and civil contractors and aims to capitalize on the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. The solution provides specialized functionality for project management, accounting, and labor cost management, integrating with existing estimating systems like HCSS HeavyBid and B2W.

title: Microsoft Phone Link upgrades the name, look, and feel of Your Phone companion
summary: Microsoft is rebranding its "Your Phone" companion app as "Phone Link," bringing a new interface and improved features. The update includes more prominent notifications, tabbed navigation, and a simpler setup process, particularly for Windows 11 users who will be able to connect via QR code. The app's design has also been updated to align with the visual style of Windows 11, featuring more rounded corners and simplified icons, aiming to enhance the seamless phone-to-PC experience.

title: BlackRock uses Azure to strengthen Aladdin, its investment management platform
summary: BlackRock is migrating its Aladdin investment platform to Microsoft Azure to enhance scalability, flexibility, and global reach for its clients. This strategic move allows BlackRock to deliver new products faster, meet client demands in more geographies, and innovate beyond the constraints of on-premises infrastructure. The migration is well underway, with about two-thirds of client instances already moved, demonstrating significant technological and business benefits.

title: 3 things learned from Microsoft’s carbon removal report
summary: Microsoft's latest carbon removal report reveals insights from its efforts to achieve net-zero by 2030. The company saw fewer, but higher quality, proposals for carbon removal projects after refining its RFP criteria. Microsoft is diversifying its high-durability solutions beyond direct air capture and continues to invest in biochar for medium-durability carbon storage.

title: Quantum uncertainty: Is quantum computing really ready for action in business?
summary: A survey indicates a growing interest in quantum computing among business executives, with many planning or already working with the technology. However, experts like Professor Sankar Das Sarma warn against the significant hype, suggesting that practical commercial applications are still a distant prospect and many current proposed use cases are not commercially viable yet. Analysts also note that while investment is flowing into quantum companies, true commercial applications remain scant, and broad adoption will likely come through hyperscale cloud providers in 5-10 years.

title: Five Tech Trends That Will Shape PH Businesses in 2022
summary: This article identifies five key tech trends that will influence Philippine businesses in 2022, as highlighted by SAP. These trends include accelerating digital transformation, prioritizing sustainability, integrating decision intelligence and hyperautomation, the rise of low-code/no-code technologies, and ensuring a total experience (TX) strategy. The article emphasizes the importance of these advancements for organizational survival and growth in the post-pandemic era, with a focus on how SAP (NYSE: SAP) can support businesses in adopting these technologies.

title: Germany's tech giant SAP turns 50
summary: SAP, Germany's prominent tech company, celebrates its 50th anniversary as the world's most-used business software provider. Starting with five former IBM employees in 1972, SAP now serves 99 of the 100 largest global companies and aims to spearhead digitalization efforts within Germany's public administration. The company has evolved from on-premise solutions to heavily investing in cloud technology, which generated €9.4 billion in 2021, with ambitious targets for future cloud revenue.

title: Microsoft's cloud business targeted by EU antitrust regulators
summary: EU antitrust regulators are questioning Microsoft's rivals and customers regarding its cloud business and licensing deals, potentially leading to a formal investigation. European antitrust enforcers are scrutinizing whether Microsoft is leveraging its dominant position in some software markets to unfairly compete in cloud computing services, following complaints from several European tech companies. The inquiry focuses on licensing deal terms, technical limitations, and the differences in license fees between various programs.

title: Business On Air – MTR
summary: This article features an interview with Ted Suen, CIO of MTR Corporation, discussing their digital transformation strategy and its impact on their 40,000 global staff. MTR, as Hong Kong's key railway operator, has a long history of technological innovation, and its current focus is on empowering employees and improving customer experience through its Digital Workplace Initiative. Suen emphasizes that executive support and an engaging change program, including gamification and design thinking, were crucial for overcoming challenges and seizing opportunities during the implementation, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Internet of Things Market Size [2022-2029] Worth USD 2465.26 Billion | Exhibiting a CAGR of 26.4%
summary: The global Internet of Things (IoT) market is projected to reach USD 2,465.26 billion by 2029, growing at a CAGR of 26.4% from USD 384.70 billion in 2021. This growth is driven by the increasing penetration of smart cities, deployment of vehicle solutions, and strong demand from the healthcare sector. Key players like Amazon Web Services, Intel, and Microsoft are focusing on product rollouts and technological advancements.

title: ProShares Opens New Headquarters, Affirms Commitment to Greater Washington D.C. Area
summary: ProShares, a leading ETF provider, announced the opening of its new 54,000-sq.-ft. headquarters in downtown Bethesda, Maryland, reaffirming its commitment to the Greater Washington D.C. area. The move follows significant growth over the past three years, with assets under management more than doubling to over $70 billion and the launch of innovative products like the bitcoin-linked ETF (BITO). The new state-of-the-art office is designed for collaboration and positions the firm for future growth, with employees returning to in-office work.

title: AMD to buy cloud startup Pensando for $1.9 billion in data center push
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) announced its acquisition of cloud startup Pensando for $1.9 billion, excluding working capital adjustments, to strengthen its data center offerings. Pensando, founded by former Cisco engineers, provides a programmable processor and software platform used by clients like Goldman Sachs and Microsoft's Azure. This strategic move aims to boost AMD's competitiveness in the rapidly expanding data center chip market against rivals like Intel and Nvidia.

title: AMD acquires data center chip startup Pensando for $1.9B
summary: AMD announced its plan to acquire Pensando Systems Inc., a data center chip startup, for approximately $1.9 billion. Pensando develops chips that improve the efficiency of supporting tasks in data centers, such as managing storage infrastructure and coordinating network traffic, by performing these functions locally on accelerator cards attached to servers. This acquisition is expected to bolster AMD's fast-growing data center business, expanding its portfolio and enhancing its competitive position against rivals like Nvidia and Intel.

title: AMD Buying John Chambers-Backed Pensando For $1.9B To Boost Cloud, Chip Innovation
summary: AMD announced its acquisition of Pensando, an edge and cloud startup, for $1.9 billion to enhance its data center processors with Pensando's software stack and programmable packet processors. This strategic move aims to expand AMD's offerings for cloud, enterprise, and edge customers by leveraging Pensando's distributed services platform, which has been praised for its performance and efficiency. Pensando's CEO Prem Jain and his team will join AMD's Data Center Solutions Group, continuing to execute their product roadmap with increased scale and market reach.

title: Elizabeth Hamren and Blake Jorgensen Join Hasbro’s Board of Directors
summary: Hasbro, Inc. (NASDAQ: HAS) announced the appointment of Elizabeth Hamren, COO of Discord Inc., and Blake Jorgensen, EVP of Special Projects at Electronic Arts Inc., to its Board of Directors, effective April 1, 2022. These appointments are part of Hasbro's ongoing board refreshment and shareholder engagement initiatives. Both new directors bring extensive experience in technology, digital gaming, and financial acumen, which Hasbro believes will be vital for its continued growth and to unlock the value of its brands.

title: Clean Harbors’ CIO: Hybrid approach to the cloud is a win-win
summary: Clean Harbors, a hazardous waste cleanup giant, has adopted a hybrid cloud strategy, leveraging Microsoft Azure for advanced AI and RPA capabilities while retaining its core Waste Information Network (WIN) on-premises. This approach allows them to innovate with cloud services for customer-facing applications and data analytics, while ensuring the high availability and security of critical legacy systems and data, a model increasingly favored by enterprises. The company's CIO, Sharon Gabriel, highlights their cautious, methodical approach to cloud adoption, informed by past experiences and a need to manage 42 years of sensitive data.

title: New York's Simpson Thacher names first new chair since 2013
summary: Simpson Thacher & Bartlett has elected Alden Millard as its new chair, succeeding William Dougherty. Under Dougherty's leadership, the firm saw its revenue double to $2.2 billion and average equity partner profits reach $6 million. Millard, a corporate partner since 1996, will now lead the firm which thrived during the recent M&A boom.

title: Investing in esports in the context of recent events
summary: This article discusses the growth of esports, significant investment it has received, and current challenges due to global events like the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine conflict. It identifies investment opportunities in publicly traded tech companies, specialized esports firms, and esports-focused ETFs, while also raising questions about future growth amidst potential new pandemics and the integration of NFTs.

title: Oculus VisionTech Launches in AWS Marketplace
summary: Oculus VisionTech Inc., through its subsidiary ComplyTrust Inc., has launched its Forget-Me-Yes® (FMY) data privacy solution in AWS Marketplace. This makes it easier for companies worldwide to achieve compliance with various data privacy regulations like CCPA, GDPR, and LGPD, particularly for right-of-deletion requests for Salesforce.org data. The cloud-native FMY platform offers a cost-effective, scalable, and secure way to manage data subject access requests through a monthly subscription.

title: Startup Warp raises $23M to reinvent the venerable command-line terminal
summary: Warp, a developer productivity startup, has successfully raised $23 million in funding, including a $6 million seed round and a $17 million Series A round. The company aims to modernize the command-line terminal, which it believes is an outdated tool despite being used daily by developers. Warp's new terminal is built with the Rust programming language, offers a modern interface, and includes features for improved collaboration and intelligent command suggestions, moving the terminal experience into the modern era for developers.

title: Closing the Gaps with SAP Enable Now
summary: This article discusses how SAP Enable Now helps businesses improve user adoption, productivity, and experience, especially in a remote work environment. Kristina Kunad, solution owner, highlights the importance of in-application help and training, the solution's integration with other SAP products, and its ability to provide ready-to-use content. She emphasizes SAP Enable Now's role in closing skill gaps and enabling organizations to effectively utilize SAP solutions across different departments.

title: Putnam’s Collins Draws On Nature For ESG Investing Inspiration
summary: Katherine Collins, head of sustainable investing at Putnam Investments, integrates biomimicry and insights from nature, specifically honeybees, into her ESG investment strategies. After a career in traditional finance and a master's degree from Harvard Divinity School, Collins applies a unique lens to identify companies demonstrating leadership in sustainability. Her approach focuses on balancing risk and opportunity, evidenced in her co-management of Putnam Sustainable Leaders (PNOYX) and Putnam Sustainable Future (PMVYX) funds.

title: C3 AI's Ambition: World's Greatest Software
summary: Tom Siebel, CEO of C3.ai (AI), discusses his renewed vision for enterprise AI, focusing on its predictive capabilities to deliver substantial economic value to customers. Despite C3.ai's stock performance challenges and questions about its core technology and business model, Siebel remains confident in the company's platform, strategic partnerships, financial strength, and long-term goal of becoming a leading software company by innovating how businesses operate through AI-driven foresight.

title: Ball Aerospace Collaborates with Microsoft Azure on On-orbit Computing
summary: Ball Aerospace is partnering with Microsoft Azure to enhance on-orbit satellite data processing, combining Ball's space-based hardware expertise with Microsoft's cloud capabilities. This collaboration aims to create "smart" satellites that extend cloud data processing power to space, enabling faster, more flexible, and dynamic data handling for complex missions. Future demonstrations will test this software on-orbit, leveraging Microsoft Azure's integrated cloud services for advanced analytics and mission-critical government workloads.

title: Boeing and Microsoft deepen partnership in digital aviation
summary: Boeing and Microsoft are expanding their strategic partnership, with Boeing leveraging the Microsoft Cloud and its AI capabilities to modernize its critical infrastructure, streamline business processes, and accelerate digital innovation in aviation. This collaboration aims to unlock sustainable value from Boeing's data, building on a long history of the companies working together in aerospace technology.

title: Announcing The Forrester EDR Wave™: Advanced Features Are Left Behind In The Rush To XDR
summary: This article announces the release of The Forrester Wave™: Endpoint Detection And Response Providers, Q2 2022, which evaluated 15 EDR vendors across 20 criteria. The report highlights that while EDR vendors are shifting focus towards XDR, security teams still require robust EDR offerings with advanced features for improved analyst workflows, resilience, and customization. It recommends choosing EDR vendors that provide meaningful contextualization, customizable automation, and a clear product vision.

title: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. stock outperforms competitors despite losses on the day
summary: Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. stock fell 3.09% on Wednesday amidst a broader market decline, closing at $147.20. Despite the loss, the stock demonstrated mixed performance compared to competitors like Microsoft, Sony, and Activision Blizzard, which also experienced declines. The trading volume for Take-Two exceeded its 50-day average.

title: Leveraging Intel Technology as a Force for Good
summary: Intel's RISE Technology Initiative supported 63 projects in the past year, investing $9.5 million to leverage Intel technology, employee talent, and partnerships for global good. These projects address accessibility, economic recovery, education, health and life sciences, social equity and human rights, and sustainability and climate. The initiative demonstrates how technology can be a force for positive change across diverse communities worldwide.

title: House Republicans want to axe Citi contracts over bank's abortion benefits
summary: House Republicans are calling for the cancellation of government contracts with Citigroup after the banking giant announced it would cover travel costs for employees seeking abortions. Republican Rep. Mike Johnson and 44 other lawmakers argue that continuing the contract would violate the policy of not funding abortions with taxpayer money. This controversy highlights the increasing focus on companies' stances on political and social issues, with other corporations also facing scrutiny for their policies on reproductive healthcare and other contentious matters.

title: What’s Changed: 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Transportation Management Systems
summary: This article highlights the changes in the 2022 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Transportation Management Systems (TMS), outlining the core and expanded capabilities of TMS software. It details the leaders, challengers, and niche players identified by Gartner, providing insights into their strengths, weaknesses, and target markets. Key updates include the addition of 3Gtms and the absence of BluJay Solutions due to its acquisition by E2open.

title: Shuffle Board: C-Suite Moves at Nordstrom, Burlington, JD, Zappos, American Textile
summary: This article details significant C-suite personnel changes across several major retail and textile companies, including Nordstrom, Burlington Stores, JD.com, Zappos.com, and American Textile Company. Key appointments and retirements are highlighted, along with new roles aimed at strategic growth, customer experience, and sustainability within these organizations. The changes reflect ongoing efforts by these companies to adapt to market demands and streamline operations.

title: Oracle Named a 2022 Gartner® Peer Insights™ ‘Voice of the Customer’: Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms
summary: Oracle has been recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2022 Gartner® Peer Insights™ ‘Voice of the Customer’: Enterprise Low-Code Application Platforms for Oracle APEX, based on customer reviews. Oracle APEX is a low-code development platform, offered as a no-cost feature of Oracle Database and available for free on Oracle Cloud's Always Free services, empowering developers to build scalable enterprise apps. The article includes testimonials from customers praising APEX for its speed, functionality, and ability to solve business problems.

title: Meta (FB) Plans to Introduce Virtual Coins to Diversify Income
summary: Meta Platforms (FB) is exploring the introduction of virtual coins, tokens, and lending services within its applications to reduce its reliance on advertising revenue. The company plans to create in-app tokens, similar to those in games like Roblox, and also social tokens and "creator coins" for influencers, rather than a blockchain-based cryptocurrency like its failed Diem project. This strategic shift aims to diversify its income streams and engage users amidst increasing competition and regulatory scrutiny.

title: DeFiChain Adds New dTokens Corresponding to Disney, Intel, MicroStrategy, and iShares MSCI China ETF
summary: DeFiChain has announced the addition of four new decentralized tokens, or dTokens, following a community vote. These new dTokens correspond to Walt Disney Co ($dDIS), iShares MSCI China ETF ($dMCHI), MicroStrategy Incorporated ($dMSTR), and Intel Corporation ($dINTC), allowing users to gain price exposure to these traditional assets without ownership. DeFiChain, a blockchain built on the Bitcoin network, aims to provide decentralized financial applications and services, expanding its dToken universe to offer an alternative to traditional financial brokers.

title: Native Advertising Vs Social Media: What Do Audiences Prefer? Outbrain-Savanta Report
summary: A report by Outbrain and Savanta indicates a shift in consumer behavior, with global audiences planning to spend less time on social media and showing a greater preference for editorial content environments. The study reveals that consumers trust editorial sites and the ads within them more than social media, and consider native advertising less intrusive. Marketers are advised to diversify their strategies to include advertising on open-web publishers to align with these changing preferences.

title: Data Analytics Market Size to grow by USD 196.47 Billion | 32% of the market growth will originate from APAC | 17,000+ Technavio Reports
summary: The global data analytics market is projected to grow by USD 196.47 billion from 2021 to 2026, accelerating at a CAGR of 13.54%. The services component segment dominated the market in 2021 and will continue to do so. APAC is expected to contribute 32% of the market's growth, with China and India being key markets.

title: Nikon Partners with Microsoft to Produce VR and 3D Video Content
summary: Nikon has established a new wholly-owned subsidiary, Nikon Creates Corporation, which will focus on planning, shooting, and producing volumetric, VR, and 3D content. This new venture makes Nikon the first licensed partner of Microsoft’s Mixed Reality Capture Studios, leveraging high-end production technology. Nikon Creates plans to open a state-of-the-art video production facility in Tokyo in Fall 2022, offering clients advanced video solutions for entertainment and advertising.

title: Metaverse Market Size [2022-2029] Worth USD 1527.55 Billion | Exhibiting a CAGR of 47.6%
summary: The metaverse market is projected to grow significantly from USD 100.27 billion in 2022 to USD 1,527.55 billion by 2029, showcasing a CAGR of 47.6%. This growth is primarily driven by the increasing penetration of online shopping and gaming, alongside advancements in blockchain technology and VR devices. Key companies leading this expansion include Tencent Holdings Ltd., NVIDIA Corporation, Meta, and Microsoft Corporation, who are focusing on product portfolio expansion and technological innovation.

title: Identity Security Company SailPoint Acquired By Thoma Bravo -
summary: Thoma Bravo is set to acquire identity security company SailPoint Technologies for $6.9 billion, a deal that includes a "go-shop" period until May 16, 2022, allowing SailPoint to seek alternative bids. This acquisition highlights Thoma Bravo's growing presence in the cybersecurity market, adding another company to its portfolio which already includes Barracuda Networks, Proofpoint, and Sophos. SailPoint, which reported significant revenue growth in Q4 2021, brings its M&A experience and MSP partnerships to the private equity firm, further strengthening its market position.

title: Amazon unexpectedly renews employee monitoring debate
summary: Amazon's consideration of an employee monitoring tool that would block certain words and phrases like "injustice," "ethics," "living wage," and "robots" on an internal messaging app has sparked renewed debate about employee monitoring. While Amazon states its intention is to screen offensive or harassing language, critics like Paul Starkman and Andrew Konya argue that such tools risk stifling employee voices and can lead to discontent, higher turnover, and a company missing crucial truths. The article suggests that alternative HR tools exist for gathering authentic employee feedback without resorting to surveillance that could harm company culture and reputation.

title: These Black Women Launched An AI-Powered Beauty Tech And Secured Backing From Serena Ventures
summary: Parfait, an AI and facial recognition-powered beauty technology, has successfully closed a $5 million Seed funding round led by Upfront Ventures and Serena Ventures. Founded by four Black women with extensive tech backgrounds, Parfait aims to revolutionize the wig market by applying AI to solve problems like AI biases and the fragmented wig buying process for women of color. The funds will be used to enhance production and automate supply chain capabilities to provide personalized experiences for customers in the rapidly growing wig industry.

title: Arista Networks Inc. stock falls Monday, underperforms market
summary: Arista Networks Inc. (ANET) stock dropped 2.95% on Monday, closing at $127.16, underperforming the broader market. The S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average also saw declines on the same day. This marked the second consecutive day of losses for Arista Networks, bringing its stock $21.41 below its 52-week high.

title: Sony And LEGO's Parent Company Are Investing Billions Of Dollars in Epic Games
summary: Sony is investing an additional $1 billion in Epic Games, with KIRKBI (LEGO's parent company) also contributing $1 billion, to deepen their combined investment in the metaverse. This funding builds on previous investments and aims to accelerate the development of interconnected digital spaces where creators and users can interact. Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney emphasizes the goal of fostering fun, immersive brand experiences, and community building within the metaverse.

title: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott: ‘We’re In A Market Of One’
summary: ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott asserts his company is the workflow automation market leader, aiming to become a $15 billion SaaS powerhouse by building a "platform of platforms." He contends ServiceNow operates in a "market of one" due to its unique ability to integrate and automate disparate enterprise workflows onto a single, cloud-native platform, addressing what he calls "islands of automation" that hinder business flexibility and security. McDermott also emphasizes the critical role of channel partners and talent development in ServiceNow's vision for growth and innovation, including significant R&D investment and a focus on AI and low-code platforms.

title: Vnet receives acquisition offer from Chinese investment firms
summary: Vnet, formerly 21Vianet, has received an unsolicited preliminary non-binding acquisition offer from Chinese investment firms Hina Group and Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. The proposal is to acquire all outstanding ordinary shares for US$8 in cash per American depositary share. Following the announcement, Vnet's shares jumped over 20 percent, despite having fallen significantly earlier in the year.

title: Visa Inc. Appoints Teri List to its Board of Directors
summary: Visa Inc. has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at companies such as Gap Inc., DICK’S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her appointment increases Visa's board to 11 members, and she is expected to provide valuable insights on risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight.

title: Visa Appoints Teri List To Its Board
summary: Visa has announced the appointment of Teri List to its board of directors, effective April 11, 2022. Ms. List brings extensive financial and leadership experience from previous executive roles at Gap Inc., DICK'S Sporting Goods Inc., Kraft Foods Group, Inc., and The Procter and Gamble Company. Her expertise in risk management, strategic planning, and financial oversight is expected to provide diverse perspectives to Visa's board.

title: 13 must-have accessories for your new Peloton Guide
summary: This article lists 13 essential accessories for new Peloton Guide users, including dumbbells, workout mats, heart rate monitors, fans, recovery tools, and supplements. It provides specific product recommendations and explanations for how each item can enhance the Peloton Guide workout experience. The goal is to help users maximize results from their strength training with the Peloton Guide.

title: Vista Equity Invests In Critical Start; MDR Security Attracts More Venture Capital Funding
summary: Vista Equity Partners has invested approximately $215 million in Critical Start, an MDR cybersecurity services provider, highlighting strong venture capital interest in the managed detection and response (MDR) market. Critical Start, which aims for 35% growth by the end of 2022, boasts an MDR platform that resolves over 99% of security alerts and has seen annual recurring revenue grow by over 400% in the last three years. This investment follows similar funding successes for other MDR companies, underscoring the increasing demand for 24/7 cyber threat vigilance.

title: Thoma Bravo to buy cybersecurity firm SailPoint in a $6.9 bln deal
summary: Private equity firm Thoma Bravo announced its acquisition of cybersecurity firm SailPoint Technologies for $6.9 billion. SailPoint shareholders will receive $65.25 per share, representing a 31.5% premium. This deal reflects the increased demand for security software due to remote work and global conflicts, and continues Thoma Bravo's trend of significant investments in the tech sector.

title: Sungard Availability Services Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
summary: Sungard Availability Services has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in the U.S. and for protection under the CCAA in Canada, seeking to complete the process within four to six months. This follows a previous Chapter 11 filing in 2019 and insolvency proceedings for its UK subsidiary, highlighting ongoing financial distress due to declining revenue, fixed costs, and competition from cloud providers. The company's restructuring support agreement contemplates either a sale of assets or equitization of its prepetition funded debt.

title: BPCL collaborates with Microsoft to leverage cloud and AI to redefine customer experience
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd. (BPCL) and Microsoft have announced a seven-year strategic cloud partnership to accelerate BPCL's digital transformation and enhance customer experience in the oil and gas industry. This collaboration, part of BPCL's 'Project Anubhav', will leverage Microsoft's cloud and AI capabilities, including Azure, for initiatives like UFill for an innovative fueling solution, IoT-powered supply chains, and a conversational AI chatbot named Urja for customer support. The partnership aims to build a resilient, cloud-led business operation, redefine customer experience through trust, personalization, and convenience, and strengthen BPCL's business operations with security at its core.

title: 5 Tech Stocks to Buy Now According to Robert Pitts’ Steadfast Capital
summary: This article identifies five tech stocks that Robert Pitts' Steadfast Capital was bullish on as of the fourth quarter of 2021. It highlights Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS) as one of these stocks, detailing Steadfast Capital's stake and the number of hedge funds holding it. The article also includes commentary from Baron Funds regarding FIS's performance and future outlook, despite concerns about its legacy technology.

title: John Deere's supply chief Wiggins on why flexibility is key
summary: Wallas Wiggins, VP Global Supply Management & Logistics at John Deere, discusses the critical role of flexibility and strong supplier relationships in navigating challenges like the pandemic. He emphasizes the importance of employee engagement, resilience, and adapting processes to achieve desired outcomes efficiently. Wiggins highlights that the pandemic taught him valuable lessons about supporting staff and preparing for the future through diversification and risk mitigation.

title: UK gamers prepare for ‘post-console’ future, finds Amdocs
summary: Amdocs research indicates that UK gamers are increasingly ready for a "post-console" future, driven by cloud gaming and 5G connectivity. The study found high enthusiasm for cloud gaming and the metaverse, with many gamers willing to pay more for these services and forgo new hardware purchases. Key priorities for gamers include content quality and the ability to stream from any device, while concerns about the metaverse mainly revolve around its early stage, hardware costs, and internet connection capabilities.

title: AI used for chip counting at City of Dreams Manila
summary: City of Dreams Manila is now using AI technology developed by Cogniac Corp to count and verify casino chips with 99.7% accuracy, significantly increasing speed and efficiency. This implementation for a loyalty program is noted as a unique AI application in the casino industry, allowing Melco Resorts to reallocate staff to more strategic areas and enhance operational accuracy and guest experience.

title: How technology is transforming the future of performance marketing
summary: Technology is becoming increasingly vital in performance marketing, offering benefits like omnichannel mapping, real-time data, mobile-first strategies, powerful AI-driven ad stacks, and robust fraud protection tools. These advancements help brands connect with audiences more effectively, optimize ad spend, and maintain ROI in an evolving digital landscape. The article highlights how ad-tech ensures campaigns are impactful and efficient.

title: Microsoft India appoints Amrita Thapar as its CMO
summary: Microsoft India has appointed Amrita Thapar as its new Chief Marketing Officer. Thapar previously served as India communications lead at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and held a vice president role at Genpact for over 13 years. She brings more than 15 years of experience in marketing and communications to her new role, specializing in brand storytelling, digital operations, and corporate communications.

title: Wide-Moat Funds Play Defense Well
summary: The article discusses how funds investing in wide-moat companies, characterized by sustainable competitive advantages, tend to perform defensively during economic downturns. These funds, often focused on quality or dividend growth, show consistency in holding wide-moat stocks and exhibit better risk-adjusted returns and downside protection compared to funds with low-moat holdings. While wide-moat stocks can trade at a premium and may not always outperform in bull markets, their defensive characteristics make them appealing for long-term stability.

title: BPCL teams up with Microsoft to leverage cloud, AI technologies
summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) has formed a strategic cloud partnership with Microsoft to accelerate its digital transformation and foster innovation within the oil and gas industry. This collaboration, spanning seven years, will leverage Microsoft's secure cloud platform, including Azure native services for IoT and analytics, to enhance BPCL's operations, supply chains, and customer engagement. The initiative aligns with BPCL's "Project Anubhav" aimed at redefining customer experience through trust, personalization, and convenience.

title: Why the Immense Selling Pressure on the SPY ETF Must End
summary: The article discusses why the intense selling pressure on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is likely to subside, presenting a buying opportunity. It attributes recent declines to concerns surrounding major holdings like Microsoft, Amazon, and Tesla, including antitrust reviews, Rivian losses, and Elon Musk's distraction with Twitter. Despite these issues, the author argues that the fundamental strength of the top companies in the S&P 500 remains, and investors should accumulate SPY shares on dips.

title: What is Adobe Experience Cloud? CRM platform overview
summary: Adobe Experience Cloud is a comprehensive CRM platform designed for medium to large enterprises, offering tools to manage sales, marketing, and customer support. It facilitates the customer journey through data-driven insights with integrated features like targeted list generators, email campaigns, and real-time data updates. The platform also integrates with various third-party systems and social media, providing a unified view of customer interactions and supporting personalized digital experiences.

title: Announcing Analyst Experience: SOC Analysts Finally Escape The Shackles Of Bad UX
summary: Forrester introduces "Analyst Experience" (AX), a new framework addressing the inadequate tools and processes faced by Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts. AX aims to improve security analysts' interactions with security products, services, and processes, building on concepts like user experience (UX) and customer experience (CX). The framework outlines five elements—discover, explore, classify, determine, and execute—to enhance the SOC workflow and will be a key focus in upcoming security technologies.

title: Worker expectations push employers to address pay compression, survey finds
summary: A Robert Half survey reveals that market conditions and employee expectations are compelling employers to address pay compression, with 56% observing discrepancies between new hires and tenured staff. In response, 62% of executives are regularly reviewing compensation plans and increasing salaries for existing employees. This proactive approach is driven by the fact that many employees plan to ask for raises due to living costs, and a significant portion would seek new employment if denied.

title: Putting zero trust into practice: An overview of Zscaler’s platform offerings, solution elements, and partner ecosystem
summary: This article provides a comprehensive overview of Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) platform, detailing its components designed to secure users, workloads, and IoT/OT systems. It explains how integrated solutions like Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) enable secure connectivity and data protection. The piece also highlights Zscaler's ecosystem integrations that consolidate vendor services and optimize cloud access.

title: Microsoft Launches Operator Connect Accelerator
summary: Microsoft has introduced the Operator Connect Accelerator program to help carriers achieve Operator Connect accreditation more quickly. This initiative involves certified partners assisting service providers with API integration, managed SBC as a service, and other necessary steps to streamline the process. The program aims to reduce time-to-market for telecom services integrating with Microsoft Teams, making it easier for businesses to adopt Teams as their primary phone system.

title: LinkedIn was the most exploited brand in phishing attacks last quarter
summary: LinkedIn became the most exploited brand in phishing attacks during Q1 2022, accounting for 52% of all analyzed attempts, a significant jump from 8% in the previous quarter. Cyber threat intelligence provider Check Point Research reported this surge, noting that phishers are increasingly leveraging social networks. The article details examples of these attacks, including spoofed LinkedIn and Maersk emails, and offers tips to avoid falling victim to phishing.

title: Digital Transformation That Sticks: Creating a Capabilities Ecosystem for Effective Learning
summary: This article argues that successful digital transformation requires creating a capabilities ecosystem rather than relying on traditional training models. It contrasts two hypothetical companies: one that fails due to an inadequate "learn as you go" approach, and another that succeeds by implementing a holistic capabilities ecosystem. This ecosystem integrates organizational change management, instructional design, and other disciplines to align learning with business strategy, foster continuous support, and build organizational resilience.

title: The rise of mini data centers
summary: The article discusses the growing trend of mini data centers, which are becoming crucial for edge computing as data demands increase. These compact, cost-effective facilities reduce latency by bringing computing power closer to users, making them ideal for densely populated areas and various applications in retail, banking, and offices. The global market for mini data centers is projected to reach $8.6 billion by 2027, with significant investments in regions like Asia-Pacific, particularly India.

title: FIS’ Modern Banking Platform Now Available on the Microsoft Azure Cloud Platform
summary: FIS announced that its Modern Banking Platform is now available on the Microsoft Azure cloud, expanding digital online banking services to financial institutions in the UK, Thailand, and New Zealand. This platform integrates advanced cloud security, monitoring, resiliency, and operational analytics with a cloud-native core, utilizing AI and component-based architecture. This partnership enables banks to quickly develop and deliver new products and services, adapting to regulatory changes and escalating customer expectations.

title: IBM Revenue Up 8% on Continued Momentum in Hybrid Cloud Business
summary: International Business Machines Corp. reported an 8% revenue increase in the first quarter, surpassing analysts' expectations, driven primarily by strong performance in its hybrid cloud platform. Revenue rose to $14.2 billion from $13.19 billion a year earlier, beating the anticipated $13.78 billion. This growth reflects the continued momentum in IBM's hybrid cloud business, which saw a 14% revenue increase, highlighting its importance in the company's transformation strategy.

title: Netflix Loses $54 Billion in Market Cap After Biggest One-Day Stock Drop Ever
summary: Netflix experienced its biggest one-day stock drop ever, losing $54 billion in market capitalization after announcing its first subscriber loss in over a decade and projecting further losses. Analysts downgraded the stock, citing market saturation, increased competition, and the impact of account sharing, leading to a significant reassessment of the company's growth prospects.

title: Latest Oracle Exadata servers ascend to the cloud
summary: Oracle has announced the availability of its latest Exadata Cloud Infrastructure X9M appliance in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, marking the rollout of its newest generation of Exadata processors. This new service, based on AMD microprocessors, offers significant improvements in performance, throughput, and capacity without increased costs, allowing organizations to consolidate various database workloads. Oracle claims superior performance compared to AWS RDS and Azure SQL, with the service designed for scalable deployment both on-premises and across Oracle's expanding global cloud footprint.

title: JPMorgan Chase, Microsoft among growing number of companies turning to neurodiverse workers to help meet need for talent
summary: A growing number of companies, including JPMorgan Chase and Microsoft, are actively recruiting neurodiverse individuals to fill talent needs and leverage their unique skills. This trend is driven by an increasing recognition of the neurodiverse population, their problem-solving abilities, and the ongoing demand for talent, with companies implementing structured programs for interviewing, hiring, and onboarding. These initiatives not only provide career opportunities for neurodiverse workers but also positively impact company culture and team dynamics.

title: Arista Networks Inc. stock falls Wednesday, underperforms market
summary: Arista Networks Inc. (ANET) stock fell 1.30% on Wednesday to $127.16, underperforming the broader market. The stock closed $21.41 below its 52-week high and also trailed competitors like Microsoft, Cisco Systems, and HP Inc., which all saw gains. Trading volume for Arista Networks exceeded its 50-day average.

title: Apple Spends Record High on Lobbying Amid Pressure from Congress
summary: Apple Inc. spent a record $2.5 million on lobbying in the first quarter of 2022, marking a 34% increase from the previous quarter. This significant expenditure comes as the company faces growing pressure from the U.S. Congress regarding antitrust concerns. Other major tech companies like Alphabet, Meta, and Microsoft are also heavily investing in lobbying efforts as Congress considers antitrust legislation that could impact the technology sector.

title: International Business Machines Corp. stock outperforms market on strong trading day
summary: International Business Machines Corp. (IBM) shares rose 1.11% to $139.85, outperforming a generally down market where the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average both fell. This marks the third consecutive day of gains for IBM, which also outperformed competitors like Apple, Microsoft, and Alphabet. The company closed $6.14 below its 52-week high, and its trading volume was more than double its 50-day average.

title: Lapsus$ Cyberattack Victim List: Globant, Microsoft, Nvidia, Okta, Samsung, T-Mobile -
summary: The Lapsus$ hacker group continued to target high-profile companies even after some alleged members were arrested in March 2022. This article lists several major companies, including Globant, Microsoft, Nvidia, Okta, Samsung, and T-Mobile, that have been victims of Lapsus$ cyberattacks. It also provides guidance on how to protect against and respond to ransomware attacks, emphasizing data backups, multi-factor authentication, and prompt incident reporting.

title: ST looks to integrate AzureRTOS with microcontroller IP
summary: STMicroelectronics has expanded its support for Microsoft's Azure RTOS within the STM32Cube development environment, now covering an extensive range of STM32 microcontrollers. This integration allows Azure RTOS to leverage key intellectual property in STM32 MCUs, including hardware crypto cores, and provides developers with free, certified, and user-friendly tools. The move aims to lower the barrier to entry for embedded systems development with Azure RTOS, offering comprehensive middleware, application examples, and support for various STM32 boards.

title: Northwell Health Collaborates with Teladoc Health to Improve System Wide Virtual Care
summary: Northwell Health, New York's largest healthcare provider, has partnered with Teladoc Health to expand its virtual care services. This collaboration will leverage Teladoc Health's platform and its integration with Microsoft Teams to enhance clinical teamwork, communication, and patient access to a broad spectrum of clinical services through a unified consumer experience. The implementation begins with 20 Northwell Health hospitals, aiming to optimize direct-to-consumer telehealth programs for improved access and quality of care.

title: Leaked Chats Show LAPSUS$ Stole T-Mobile Source Code – Krebs on Security
summary: Leaked private chat messages from the LAPSUS$ cybercrime group reveal they breached T-Mobile multiple times in March 2022, stealing source code for various projects. Despite T-Mobile's claim that no customer or government information was compromised, the chats detail LAPSUS$'s methods, including purchasing access, social engineering employees, and utilizing internal tools like Atlas to look up sensitive accounts. The article also highlights the group's internal conflicts, their leader's fixation on stealing source code, and their eventual undoing due to compromised servers and arrests.

title: Cloud Architect: The Tech Skill Everyone Wants to Learn?
summary: Cloud architecture is rapidly becoming the most sought-after tech skill, with a 285% jump in class participation on Udemy. This demand is driven by the widespread adoption of cloud infrastructure by organizations, leading to a significant skills shortage. Cloud architects command a median annual salary of $131,513 and require expertise in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and continuous learning of diverse technical and soft skills.

title: Kraft Heinz and Microsoft join forces to accelerate supply chain transformation
summary: Kraft Heinz is partnering with Microsoft to digitally transform its supply chain using Microsoft Azure, marking its largest technology investment to date. This collaboration aims to create a more resilient supply chain by establishing a "supply chain control tower" and "digital twins" of manufacturing facilities, leveraging AI, IoT, and data analytics. The initiative seeks to enhance operational efficiency, anticipate consumer demand, and optimize product delivery for Kraft Heinz's extensive portfolio.

title: Solve Customer Mysteries With Quantitative And Qualitative Investigation
summary: This article emphasizes the importance of combining quantitative and qualitative approaches to achieve true customer understanding. It highlights how a siloed approach often fails to provide a holistic view of customers and suggests that customer experience practitioners should lead the integration of both types of analysis. The author will be speaking at Forrester’s CX APAC event to present best practices for using combined methods to solve customer mysteries, using examples like churn analysis.

title: What is fintech and why does it matter?
summary: Fintech, a combination of “financial” and “technology,” refers to software that makes financial processes more accessible and automates traditional financial services. Kirsty Rutter, Fintech Investment Director at Lloyds Banking Group, explains how fintech is transforming banking by improving customer experiences through technologies like AI and machine learning. Lloyds Banking Group is actively investing in and collaborating with fintech companies to enhance its services and maintain a competitive edge.

title: Tim Aimone – Hewlett Packard Enterprise
summary: Tim Aimone, Director of Workplace Design and Project Management at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), led the design of the company's new Houston headquarters. Opened in February 2022, the innovative office space is a "workplace of the future" designed for a hybrid work model, emphasizing collaboration, comfort, and integration of technology. The design prioritizes flexibility and employee well-being, reflecting lessons learned from the pandemic and HPE's existing "work from the edge" philosophy.

title: How LV Vaidyanathan, the Satya Nadella fan, is looking to rewrite P&G India's fortunes
summary: LV Vaidyanathan, a P&G veteran and IIM-Ahmedabad alumnus, is set to take over as P&G India's head from July 1, 2022. He aims to transform the company's operations in India to capitalize on the country's strong growth prospects in the FMCG market. Inspired by Satya Nadella, Vaidyanathan plans to change the company's culture and image, focusing on product superiority, innovation, and sustainability.

title: Low Volatility Stocks Usually Do Well—But There Are Traps
summary: A Northern Trust Asset Management paper warns that while low-volatility stocks generally outperform over time, they can present traps, particularly in real estate, utilities, and consumer staples sectors. Rising interest rates and economic vulnerability can negatively impact these types of low-volatility holdings. NTAM advises focusing on companies with strong cash flows, profitability, and solid balance sheets to mitigate these risks.

title: Funds That Buy Like Buffett, 2022
summary: This article identifies mutual funds that invest similarly to Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway. It highlights funds that hold a high percentage of the same stocks as Buffett's portfolio, with a particular focus on Apple. The piece also discusses the investment strategies of these funds and their performance.

title: Crescent Hotels & Resorts Adds Aloft Mountain View to Latitudes Collection
summary: Crescent Hotels & Resorts has expanded its Latitudes Collection with the addition of the Aloft Mountain View. This property, formerly a Hilton Garden Inn, underwent extensive renovations and is designed to attract energetic business travelers with its vibrant, tech-savvy atmosphere and modern amenities. Located near major tech companies in Silicon Valley, the hotel offers a 24/7 fitness center, an outdoor heated pool, event space, and on-site dining options.

title: Microsoft (MSFT) Q3 revenue up 18%, earnings beat estimates
summary: Microsoft Corp. reported strong third-quarter 2022 results, with revenues increasing by 18% to $49.4 billion, surpassing analyst expectations. The company's net income also rose to $16.7 billion, or $2.22 per share, exceeding estimates. This performance was significantly driven by a 29% growth in server products and cloud services revenue, particularly Azure.

title: Kraft Heinz taps Microsoft to build up supply chain visibility
summary: Kraft Heinz is partnering with Microsoft to enhance its supply chain visibility and resilience. The collaboration involves creating a "Supply Chain Control Tower" and "digital twins" of 34 manufacturing facilities using Microsoft's Azure, machine learning, and analytics to improve efficiency and address disruptions. This move is part of Kraft Heinz's broader digital transformation strategy.

title: Android Can Now Sync with Windows PCs via Phone Link App, Like Apple Devices
summary: Android phones can now sync with Windows PCs through Microsoft's Phone Link app, enabling users to access notifications, messages, and calls directly from their computer, similar to how Apple devices operate. This integration, especially with Windows 11, allows for seamless management of smartphone features and even enables running Android native applications on the PC. The setup involves simple QR code scanning and ensures updated operating systems and apps for both devices.

title: Equinix Q1 2022: xScale Quarterly Leasing Activity Drops to Zero
summary: Equinix reported its Q1 2022 earnings, showing a 10% year-over-year revenue increase but also a significant halt in leasing activity for its hyperscale xScale facilities. The company provided financial guidance for 2022, continued its global data center expansion, and outlined recent acquisitions and joint ventures, while noting that no new xScale capacity was leased in the quarter.

title: Kraft-Heinz Credits Growth To Core, Conventional Lines and Company’s ‘Consumer Obsession’
summary: Kraft Heinz reported a 6.8% increase in Q1 2022 organic net sales, attributing its success to the affordability of core brands, strategic hedging against inflation, and responsive retail demand. The company also saw significant growth in its foodservice arm and international expansion, while leveraging data-driven insights and AI for product innovation and marketing.

title: Slack is definitely part of Salesforce now, and here’s proof
summary: Salesforce and Slack are launching "Salesforce Platform for Slack," allowing developers to build functionality that integrates Salesforce data into Slack. This move solidifies Slack's integration with its parent company, offering enhanced collaboration and automation capabilities while still maintaining compatibility with third-party business tools. Slack cofounder Cal Henderson provides a nuanced perspective on the acquisition, highlighting the benefits of working with Salesforce's thriving ecosystem.

title: Why AWS, Microsoft, Google, Visa Are Setting Base In Kenya
summary: Major tech companies like Amazon Web Services, Microsoft, Google, and Visa are establishing operations in Kenya due to its growing economy and increasing client demand for cloud computing services. Kenya's strategic location as East Africa's largest economy and a hub for Fortune 500 companies makes it an attractive market for expansion. This move is driven by the need to meet local data residency requirements and capitalize on the burgeoning African cloud computing industry.

title: Oracle teams with Verizon as it expands global network of industry innovation labs
summary: Oracle has opened a new 30,000 sq ft Industry Lab near Chicago, in partnership with Verizon, to allow customers and partners to develop and test solutions using Oracle's technology across various industries. This lab will initially focus on energy and water, construction and engineering, communications, and manufacturing, with additional labs planned for England and Australia. The initiative aims to address complex industry challenges through collaborative innovation in simulated real-world environments.

title: HCL Technologies brings All Access Media Marketplace Platform
summary: HCL Technologies has launched its All Access Media Marketplace Platform at NAB Las Vegas, aiming to streamline content creation and distribution processes. Developed in coordination with Microsoft and CoreSite, the platform addresses workflow, application, and vendor discovery challenges for media creators. It features HCL Workflow Creator for building workflows, leverages Microsoft 365 for communication, and utilizes Azure Cloud for cybersecurity, aligning with MovieLabs 2030 Vision.

title: Ansys simulation software to be used in CU Boulder graduate program
summary: Ansys Inc., an engineering simulation software company based in Pittsburgh, is partnering with the University of Colorado Boulder. Their software will be integrated into the university's new Professional Master’s Program in High-Speed Digital Engineering. This collaboration aims to provide students with advanced simulation tools relevant to their field.

title: Electronic Arts seeks more influencers as it opens Creator Network to all
summary: Electronic Arts is expanding its Creator Network, previously an invite-only initiative, to all influencers globally. This program aims to build direct connections with various content creators, offering them early access to games, mentorship, and resources. EA plans to grow the network to 5,000 active members by the end of 2022 to enhance content creation around its brands.

title: Advisors Are Powering Portfolios With Thematic ETFs
summary: Thematic ETFs, which invest in companies poised to benefit from long-term transformative changes, are increasingly being adopted by financial advisors as a replacement for traditional sector funds.
